jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Role summary

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day.

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted.

Responsibilities

  • Product vision, grounded in real user needs

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind.

  • Market scoping and opportunity-spotting

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog.

  • Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you.

  • The full lifecycle

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear.

  • The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together.

The team you’ll join

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today.

Life at Bluerock

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.


  • 5+ years in product or project management within logistics, supply chain, or TMS — hands-on TMS experience is required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Information Systems, Supply Chain/Logistics, or a related field  required.

  • A track record of delivering complex, high-stakes software implementations, on time and within budget.

  • Genuine ease operating cross-functionally. You connect engineering, sales, implementation, and customers without waiting for permission.

  • An appetite for ambiguity and change: a messy, fragmented workflow reads to you as an interesting problem.

  • Nice to have: API integration experience (WMS, ERP, visibility providers, customs), fluency with Agile tooling (Jira, Asana, Rocketlane), and PMP/PRINCE2 certification.

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and guide cross-functional teams.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage customer relationships and stakeholder expectations effectively.

  • Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a focus on delivering results in a fast-paced environment

Our hiring process

  • Hit the Apply button.

  • Join a 30 minute video call in the Introduction Interview

  • A couple of deeper interviews built to be a win-win, not an interrogation.

  • An offer, and the start of your journey with Bluerock TMS.


Bluerock TMS is an equal opportunities employer. We take pride in our diverse workforce and inclusive workplace. Within a small team of open-minded talents, we ensure an attractive learning environment that you are looking for!

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Own

  • Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

  • Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

  • Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

  • Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

  • Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

  • Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

  • Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation

What We're Looking For

  • Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

  • Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

  • Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states, partners you don't control).

  • AI judgement - hands-on with LLM-based products; can frame a feature as eval-able (offline, online, human feedback); realistic on hallucination/drift/data gaps, including data-blocked vs model-blocked and when a model must not be in the loop at all.

  • Nice to have - engineer or highly-technical-PM background · zero-to-one · shipped AI-heavy consumer products · defined eval metrics for ML/LLM systems · AI UX + failure-handling intuition · SEA market experience.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
jobs.description:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Private Wealth (f/m/d) you build the product for LIQID's most demanding clients: entrepreneurs, families and executives whose relationship with us runs through a personal Relationship Manager. You design for two users at once – the client and the RM – and your mandate is twofold: make our Relationship Managers radically more effective, and design the end-to-end hybrid service, sales and relationship model for our most complex offerings. Our private clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You make sure that advising on, investing in and living with these portfolios feels like the best of private banking – with the speed and clarity of a digital product.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the private client journey from introduction and first advisory meeting through onboarding, investment and long-term servicing to the next allocation. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree – net new money, share of wallet, time from advisory to investment, private markets adoption, retention, RM book capacity and cost-to-serve – and develop it further where you see sharper signals.

  • RM Enablement & Advisory Tooling: Treat Relationship Managers as users, not stakeholders. You build the tools that give them more time for advice and less for administration: a client 360 view, meeting preparation and follow-up, next-best-action signals, pipeline visibility and AI copilots that draft, summarize and document – within the requirements of MiFID II on suitability, cost transparency and record-keeping.

  • Hybrid Service & Sales Design: Blueprint the service model end-to-end: which moments are digital, which are personal, and which are both. Together with RM and Sales leadership you design seamless handovers, a shared view between client app and RM workspace, and service tiers that scale high-touch quality to more clients without diluting it.

  • Complex Offerings, Made Simple: Make sophisticated products understandable and executable: private markets with capital calls, distributions and J-curves, and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, as well as bespoke mandates, company and holding accounts, family structures and consolidated reporting across portfolios. You work closely with the Investment team, Compliance and Operations so every journey is compliant by design.

  • Discovery, Data & Experimentation: Join advisory meetings, shadow RMs and run continuous discovery with clients for whom every interaction matters. You combine qualitative depth with rigorous measurement in a small-n, high-value segment, define tracking schemas for client and RM journeys, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles.

  • Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops. You drive adoption of what you ship inside the RM organization, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for hybrid wealth management at LIQID.

What you bring

  • Background: 7+ years in Product Management, ideally in wealth management, private banking, FinTech or another trust-driven, advice-led domain. Experience building for internal expert users such as advisors, sales or service teams alongside end clients is a strong plus.

  • Service Design & Hybrid Thinking: You think in service models, not just screens. You have designed journeys that span people, processes and software, and you know how to drive adoption and behavior change inside an organization, not only ship features to it.

  • Domain Depth & Regulatory Fluency: Solid understanding of investing and wealth management (capital markets, private markets, portfolio construction), and the ambition to build regulatory fluency in a supervised environment (MiFID II, BaFin). Experience with private market products or advisory processes is a strong plus.

  • Analytical & Technical Fluency: You define metrics before you build and attribute impact credibly, even with small samples. You are comfortable with CRM and workflow integrations, discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers, and using AI tooling to prototype and to build AI-assisted workflows.

  • Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, with the presence to earn credibility with experienced Relationship Managers and with clients who expect the highest standard – and to represent your roadmap toward leadership.

  • Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. You want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to define what a premium hybrid private client experience looks like in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.

What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Call with Head of Product: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round: A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments.

 

About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

 

LIQID is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by equal opportunity laws.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Software
jobs.description:
About Optics11

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role

As Senior Product Manager Software you will build a deep understanding of the software we supply to our defense partners and clients.

You will have full product ownership including strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle and contribute to adjacent hardware product strategy and propositions to, jointly with our hardware product managers, build end-to-end solutions for our defense partners and clients. You build and structure our product discovery and delivery ways of working for the software domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our hardware Product Managers, Data science, Software, R&D, Engineering Sales, Projects and Application Engineering teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might speak with a defense partner about an operational challenge, turn feedback from a deployed product into a roadmap decision, test the feasibility of a new capability with System Engineering, or work with the Product Owner to translate priorities into executable increments. You will also collaborate with hardware Product Managers, Engineering, Sales and Customer Projects to ensure our software and hardware come together as one coherent solution.

You will own the software product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle, from discovery and business case through prioritization, delivery and performance.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have established a clear, evidence-based software strategy, strengthened our discovery and delivery practices, and aligned teams around the capabilities that matter most. Your work will reduce uncertainty, improve investment decisions and help Optics11 deliver scalable, commercially strong software products that solve real problems for customers operating in demanding, high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the software product strategy by defining and articulating the direction for assigned software products or value streams, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balance near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

• Provide product design authority by ensuring software concepts, capabilities and development choices remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, operational use cases and buying contexts, validating direction with customers and partners, and synthesizing feedback from deployed products.

• Own software roadmap development and prioritization by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and communicating priorities across relevant teams.

• Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures and commercial objectives, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and supporting Product Marketing with product knowledge for pricing and launch readiness.

• Coordinate the product core team by working with System Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership on executable increments, and Project Management on customer delivery, while aligning Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes.


• Master’s degree in engineering or design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Software Product Management, with a proven track record of developing, deploying and maintaining software (platform) driven solutions in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Strong understanding of software products, particularly in complex and regulated environments, e.g., industrial environments.

• In-depth knowledge of software product management and – strategy methodologies.

• Demonstratable experience in defining software product strategy and creating complete business cases.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level

• Demonstrated critical thinking, adaptability to challenges, and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user pain points.

• Proficiency in software industry standard tooling for software development and road mapping such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery / Jira Service Management, Confluence, BigPicture

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying product level knowledge, decisions and roadmaps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel

• Drivers’ license B (or international equivalent)

Nice to Have

• Experience in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Proficiency in JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, SAFe, Miro, Figma, Dovetail, Amplitude, PowerBI

• Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Security screening

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please check:

https://english.aivd.nl/topics/s/security-screening

Kraken Customer

From optimising resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Senior Frontend Engineer (m/f/x) 

Location: EU/UK 

(Remote) 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

We're a fast-growing, innovative company that thrives on creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning. If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Frontend Engineers who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

  • Frontend Feature Development: Design, develop and maintain frontend features and functionalities across the company's platform, delivering intuitive and reliable user experiences. 

  • Angular Ownership: Take ownership of the Angular codebase, driving its ongoing development, maintenance and technical direction. 

  • Frontend Architecture & Standards: Lead frontend architectural decisions and establish scalable patterns, reusable components and consistent development practices. 

  • Design Systems & Component Libraries: Develop and maintain shared UI components and design systems to improve consistency, accessibility and development efficiency across the platform. 

  • Testing & Code Quality: Implement automated tests, including unit, integration and end-to-end testing, to ensure application reliability and maintainability. 

  • Performance & Maintenance: Investigate and resolve bugs, optimise frontend performance and continuously improve existing functionality. 

  • Product Collaboration: Work closely with the Product Owner and engineering team to translate product requirements and domain logic into clear technical solutions. 

  • Cross-Functional Delivery: Contribute to product development across different areas of the business, collaborating with backend and frontend engineers to deliver agreed roadmap priorities. 

  • Technical Problem-Solving: Navigate an evolving codebase, investigate existing implementations and work independently to solve complex technical and product challenges. 

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve development workflows, technical practices and the overall quality and scalability of the platform. 


  • Frontend Development: Several years of professional frontend development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in Angular, preferably version 17 or later. 

  • Angular Expertise: Comfortable working with the Angular Signals API, RxJS and observable patterns, and modern Angular development practices. 

  • Frontend Architecture: Experience making frontend architectural decisions, establishing coding standards and maintaining scalable, maintainable applications. 

  • Component Libraries & Design Systems: Experience building and maintaining design systems and reusable component libraries, including applying smart/dumb component patterns. 

  • Reusable & Accessible Components: Experience building accessible, reusable UI components using Angular Material or equivalent component libraries. 

  • Automated Testing: Experience writing and maintaining unit, integration and end-to-end tests, including hands-on experience with Playwright. 

  • Product Engineering: Ability to translate product requirements and domain logic into effective user experiences and reliable functionality. 

  • Independent Delivery: Self-directed and delivery-focused, able to manage workload independently and take ownership of features from implementation through to release. 

  • Problem-Solving & Quality: Strong debugging skills, attention to detail and the ability to resolve bugs, improve performance and maintain code quality. 

  • Communication & Collaboration: Clear communicator who works effectively with product owners, engineers and cross-functional stakeholders. 

  • Legally permitted to work within the EU or UK.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You own Banking Experience: the accounts at the center of customer's relationship with the bank, and the API and dashboards they use to manage them.

In this role you’re responsible for redefining what beautiful software in banking looks like. You'll define account structures that give customers powerful building blocks for their products, and craft intuitive interfaces grounded in a deep understanding of their use cases and workflows.

You report to Will, Head of Product, and work closely with Simon, our CTO. You're expected to operate with full autonomy on your team's roadmap, collaborating with design and engineering.

Your First Six Months

  • Months 1-2: Take over day-to-day ownership of the Banking Experience team - the roadmap, the ways of working, the hard decisions. Establish yourself with customers and how they use our accounts. You define and ship your first project.

  • Months 3-4: Execution mode. You're unblocking engineering daily, making hard prioritization calls, and shipping your roadmap to customers. You're proactively raising the bar across accounts, API, and dashboard by feeding what you learn from customers into the product.

  • Months 5-6: You're working with live customers on the products you've built. Deposits and number of account holders are scaling. You've moved from execution to platform mode - evolving the roadmap based on what our customers are building on top of Augustus.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You want to spend time with customers to intimately understand and then innovate on their workflows.

  • You’re a structured and relentless problem solver.

  • You combine first-principles thinking with deep domain knowledge to make complex processes simple.

  • You have taste and care deeply about the quality of what you build.

  • You leverage AI to push the boundaries of what a PM can do.

  • You’re excited about building a programmable bank and helping shape what that means.

Hard Requirements

  • Experience end-to-end owning and building banking, fintech, or developer platform products.

  • Technical enough to spar on architectural decisions with engineers - you're comfortable in API design discussions, not just UI reviews.

  • You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, finance, or developer tools companies.

  • You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple

  • Comfortable in customer-facing roles - you've pitched, demoed, and closed early adopters yourself.

  • Based in New York or Berlin, or willing to relocate.

Pay transparency

Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual US base salary range for this role is $180,000-$230,000 + equity.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

  • Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.

  • Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.

  • Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.

Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.

Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Product Owner Finance
jobs.description:
About Weezevent

From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats.

We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control, CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world.

Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year.

Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy).

Key Responsibilities:

Product Vision and Strategy: execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands.

Stakeholder Collaboration: act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features.
Detect and report payments incidents when impacting organizers appreciation.
Communicate the product vision and strategy effectively to stakeholders and team members.
Provide operational support to the Client success and Finance teams. Providing help for PSP configurations, responding to questions in Slack, triaging RUN requests and generating custom exports is key for the well functioning of the company.

Product Backlog Management: create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements.
Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.

Development and Delivery: work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines.
Review, QA and accept completed user stories to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria and deliver the expected value.

Market and User Research: analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology.

Compliance and Risk Management: ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with financial products and solutions with a strong emphasis on compliance and regulatory adherence.

Performance Monitoring: monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators.
Implement changes and improvements based on performance metrics and user feedback.

Why it's a good move ?
You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance.

Fundamentals to join us :

  • You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ;

  • You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory.

  • You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

  • You speak French fluently.

Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk !

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Compensation and benefits

We offer a salary of EUR 50,400–65,000 per year for this permanent contract based in Clichy with a hybrid working arrangement. Private health insurance is provided to cover your medical needs. Public transportation benefits support your daily commute. Paid sick leave ensures you have time to recover when needed. Home Office options offer flexibility in your weekly schedule. A casual dress code allows you to wear what makes you comfortable at work. Regular team events and social activities keep you connected with colleagues. A company laptop is provided from your first day.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Problem You'll Solve

Prosus is building an AI-first future across a global portfolio that spans food delivery, e-commerce, fintech, and education. We invest over $100 million annually in AI, run 800+ models in production, and have deployed Toqan — our internal platform for building, testing, and deploying GenAI and agentic workflows — across the organisation. The scale of ambition is real; the challenge now is focus, coherence, and velocity.

As Group Product Manager for our AI Platform, you will own the multi-year product strategy for the platform that underpins every AI initiative across Prosus. This means defining and sequencing the roadmap for agent infrastructure, evaluation frameworks, model deployment pipelines, and the shared capabilities that internal teams — from applied science to application engineering — rely on to build and ship AI products. You will balance long-term platform investments against the immediate, high-impact needs of teams across the portfolio who are racing to deliver.

You will lead and mentor a team of product managers, instilling product discipline and building the PM talent pipeline that scales with the platform. You will partner closely with engineering and applied science leadership to shape the technical strategy — making the hard trade-offs between model performance, latency, cost, and reliability that determine what we can promise the business.

And you will be the connective tissue: the person who turns ambiguous, fast-moving business needs into clear requirements, who aligns stakeholders across functions and geographies, and who ensures that what we build is not just technically impressive but adopted, trusted, and measurably impactful.

Who You Are

You are a senior product leader who has lived through the messy reality of building platform products for internal teams — and loved it. You measure your success not by features shipped but by the velocity and quality of the teams who build on top of your platform.

You are deeply technical. You can engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on model lifecycle, MLOps, evaluation frameworks, and infrastructure trade-offs — not as a bystander, but as a thought partner. You understand agentic architectures, LLM capabilities and limitations, and the operational realities of running AI in production at scale.

You are a people leader. You have managed and mentored product managers, and you take genuine pride in their growth. You set strategic direction, coordinate overlapping roadmaps into a coherent plan, and create the clarity that lets your team operate with autonomy and purpose.

You thrive in ambiguity. You have worked in fast-paced, high-scale environments where priorities shift and the path forward is not always clear. You do not wait for perfect information — you run rapid experiments, test hypotheses, and let data and user feedback guide the next step.

You are a communicator. You can simplify complex technical concepts for executive leadership one hour and dig into detailed requirements with an engineering team the next. You build trust across functions and geographies, and you are as comfortable pushing back as you are building consensus.

You are customer-obsessed — even when your customers are internal teams. You connect frequently with the people who use your platform, validate solutions through product discovery, and treat adoption as a first-class metric.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years in product management, with at least 3–5 years in formal people-management roles leading a team of product managers.

  • Demonstrated success owning platform-level or infrastructure products used by internal teams — ideally including AI/ML platform capabilities, MLOps tooling, or developer-facing services.

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI, LLMs, and the model lifecycle (training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring) in production environments.

  • Track record of defining and executing multi-year product strategies in fast-moving, high-scale environments.

Technical Depth

  • Ability to engage substantively with engineering and applied science teams on architectural decisions, infrastructure trade-offs, and AI system design.

  • Familiarity with agentic workflows, agent frameworks, and the operational patterns that make AI agents reliable at scale.

  • Strong data-driven decision-making: comfortable with analytics tooling, A/B testing, defining and tracking KPIs, and using metrics to measure adoption, accuracy, latency, and ROI.

  • Experience with modern product and engineering tooling (e.g., Databricks, Jira, Confluence, Figma) and agile methodologies.

Leadership & Influence

  • Proven ability to mentor and grow product managers, instilling PM best practices and building talent pipelines.

  • Stakeholder management across functions and geographies — aligning engineering, applied science, business teams, and executive leadership around a shared roadmap.

  • A bias toward ownership: you take accountability for outcomes, protect your engineers' focus, and course-correct execution without waiting to be asked.

Mindset

  • Customer-first: you translate needs into technical requirements, push back when scope dilutes value, and advocate relentlessly for the people who use your platform.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: you structure complex problems, propose pilots to validate direction, and create clarity for new and evolving teams.

  • AI intuition: you stay current on models, frameworks, and evaluation methods — not as a researcher, but with the hands-on curiosity of a builder.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

  • Excellent niveau de français à l’oral comme à l’écrit et anglais professionnel, notamment pour la production de supports et les échanges avec des interlocuteurs internationaux.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a strong technical background, hands-on project management experience and exposure to offshore or subsea environments such as cable laying, geotechnical surveys, marine operations or related activities. Depuis 10 ans, Hubvisory grandit autour de cinq valeurs : expertise, apprentissage, ambition, bienveillance et méritocratie.

Envie de donner une nouvelle dimension à ta carrière Product ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi ! 🚀


🔍 Le profil qu'on recherche

Tu as 3 à 6 ans d'expérience en Product Management sur des produits digitaux et tu as déjà eu l'occasion de piloter des sujets de bout en bout.

Tu maîtrises les fondamentaux du métier, mais surtout, tu sais les mettre en pratique dans des environnements exigeants.

46 à 58 K€ brut annuel fixe + variable + intéressement.

Postule et viens construire la suite de ton parcours avec Hubvisory !

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product owners to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Product manager - gestion des projets (CDI)
jobs.description:
🧱 À propos de Bricks

Chez Bricks, on construit la façon la plus simple d’investir dans l’immobilier, à partir de 10 €. 670 000+ membres, un produit régulé (PSFP) et une même exigence sur toute l’expérience : permettre d’investir simplement mais aussi de suivre son investissement dans la durée.

Bricks est une plateforme à deux faces : d’un côté les investisseurs, de l’autre les porteurs de projets immobiliers. Deux communautés à accompagner et faire grandir en parallèle.

Ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet compte donc autant que le moment où l’on investit : qualité de l’information, transparence, suivi des projets et gestion des situations plus complexes participent directement à l’expérience des deux côtés de la plateforme.

Quelques jalons d’une aventure assez unique : passage chez Capital (M6) en 2022, Tony Parker investisseur et ambassadeur, record européen de vitesse de levée : 5 M€ en 5 secondes, 20 M€+ en 10 jours auprès de notre communauté.

Côté business : 176 M€ collectés en 2025, +90 % en un an et la rentabilité atteinte. Notre prochain enjeu : scaler à grande échelle sans perdre la vélocité qui fait aujourd’hui partie de notre manière de travailler.

Chez Bricks, on attend de chacun qu’il comprenne vraiment les problèmes avant de chercher à les résoudre. L’objectif : prendre les bonnes décisions et construire des solutions utiles.

Sur ce poste, ton travail aura un impact direct sur la qualité du suivi des projets et sur la confiance des investisseurs comme des porteurs de projets.

Vos missions

🧩 Le job

Tu rejoins la squad gestion des projets qui est en charge de tout ce qui se passe après le financement d’un projet immobilier.

Aujourd’hui, Bricks gère environ 400 projets financés simultanément. Pour chacun d’eux, il faut suivre ce qui se passe sur le terrain : récupérer les bonnes informations auprès des porteurs de projets, communiquer régulièrement avec les investisseurs et lorsque quelque chose se passe moins bien, il faut savoir gérer les impayés, les pénalités et les éventuelles procédures de contentieux.

C’est aussi ce qui fait de la gestion post-financement l’un des sujets les plus stratégiques pour Bricks. Une plateforme d’investissement ne se construit pas uniquement au moment où un utilisateur décide d’investir : elle se construit dans la durée, dans la qualité du suivi et dans la façon dont les situations plus complexes sont prises en charge.

Le challenge n’est pas simplement de “gérer 400 projets”. Il est de construire un système capable d’en gérer demain beaucoup plus sans faire grossir l’équipe au même rythme.

Une plateforme existe déjà et accompagne l’équipe au quotidien. Elle a atteint un niveau de maturité où les prochains problèmes ne se résoudront pas uniquement avec de nouvelles features : parfois la meilleure réponse sera produit, parfois process, parfois automatisation, parfois juridique.

C’est là que tu interviens.

👉 Ce que tu vas owner

  • Comprendre profondément le quotidien des utilisateurs internes en particulier celui de la personne qui opère nos projets au quotidien : observer, écouter, identifier les irritants et comprendre ce qui peut être supprimé, automatisé ou mieux structuré.
  • Faire évoluer la gestion de plusieurs centaines de projets pour qu’elle reste fluide et scalable : priorisation, automatisation, workflows, process et outils.
  • Travailler avec l’engineering pour transformer les problèmes identifiés en solutions produit lorsqu’une solution technique est pertinente.
  • Aller chercher l’information là où elle se trouve : care, juridique, marketing, métier, engineering… Tu ne travailles pas à partir d’une spec parfaite, tu reconstruis toi-même le contexte.
  • T’approprier des sujets parfois complexes ou réglementaires. Tu n’as pas besoin d’être juriste, mais un contrat de 50 pages ou une discussion sur un process de contentieux ne doit pas te faire fuir.
  • Choisir le bon levier plutôt que la feature par défaut : modifier un process peut parfois avoir plus d’impact que développer un nouvel écran.
  • Transformer chaque problème rencontré en apprentissage réutilisable : l’objectif n’est pas de traiter le problème du projet n°237, mais de faire en sorte qu’il soit mieux géré pour les centaines de projets suivants.
  • Et progressivement, prendre de plus en plus d’ownership sur la stratégie et la roadmap de la squad. Le périmètre pourra évoluer fortement selon ce que tu démontres sur le terrain.

👥 La squad

Tu travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes en charge du suivi opérationnel des projets ainsi qu’avec l'Engineering, le Product, le Growth et Marketing.

Selon les sujets, tu seras également amené à collaborer avec le Care, le juridique ou la direction. Un même problème peut avoir des conséquences très différentes selon les équipes et les utilisateurs concernés.

C’est un rôle où la collaboration compte énormément. Ton travail ne consiste pas simplement à recueillir les besoins de chacun et à les transformer en features.

Tu dois aller chercher l’information directement auprès des personnes concernées, comprendre leur réalité opérationnelle, croiser les différents points de vue et remonter à la vraie problématique derrière une demande.

Ce qu’un utilisateur te demande n’est pas toujours la solution dont il a besoin. À toi d’agréger le contexte, de challenger les demandes et de construire avec l’équipe la réponse la plus efficace qu’elle soit produit, process, technique ou juridique.

Vos compétences

🎯 Tu fitteras si

  • Tu as au moins 3 ans d’expérience en Product Management avec déjà une vraie autonomie sur ton périmètre.
  • Tu as déjà travaillé sur un produit ou un environnement où il fallait comprendre le métier avant de construire la solution. Tu vas spontanément parler aux utilisateurs plutôt que d’attendre qu’un besoin parfaitement formulé arrive jusqu’à toi. C’est un point particulièrement important pour ce rôle.
  • Tu es à l’aise dans des environnements mouvants. Tu peux passer plusieurs jours à creuser un problème complexe, puis devoir jongler entre plusieurs sujets dans la même journée. Tu sais récupérer rapidement le contexte, identifier ce qui compte et avancer sans te perdre dans l’information
  • Tu as un vrai mindset builder/entrepreneur : tu n’as pas besoin que tout soit déjà structuré pour commencer à avancer.
  • Tu sais travailler avec des experts sans avoir besoin de devenir toi-même expert de chaque sujet. Tu peux échanger avec un juriste, un développeur, le care ou le marketing, absorber leur contexte et transformer tout ça en décisions produit cohérentes.
  • Tu sais défendre un point de vue et challenger quand c’est nécessaire y compris face à des interlocuteurs très seniors, tout en étant capable de changer d’avis quand les arguments sont meilleurs.
  • Une expérience dans un environnement régulé ou à fortes contraintes métier : fintech, legaltech, comptabilité, RH… est un vrai plus. Ici une décision produit peut avoir des conséquences financières, juridiques ou opérationnelles réelles.
  • Tu préfères faire beaucoup avec une petite équipe plutôt que de construire du process pour construire du process

❌ Tu ne fitteras probablement pas si

  • Tu as besoin d’un framework très établi pour fonctionner.
  • Tu attends des specs détaillées avant d’aller chercher toi-même le contexte.
  • Ton premier réflexe face à un problème est systématiquement de créer une feature.
  • Tu cherches à appliquer « la bonne méthode produit » indépendamment du contexte.
  • Tu préfères passer trois semaines à cadrer parfaitement un sujet plutôt que tester rapidement une hypothèse lorsque le risque le permet.
  • Ou tu imagines le rôle de PM comme quelqu’un qui organise le travail d’une squad depuis Jira : ici le Product Manager met vraiment les mains dans le problème.

Avantages

🚀 Pourquoi ce rôle est intéressant

La squad est déjà l’une des plus matures chez Bricks mais le terrain de jeu devant elle reste énorme.

Aujourd’hui, il y a environ 400 projets. Demain, il peut y en avoir 2 000 avec de nouvelles typologies de produits, de nouveaux pays et de nouveaux enjeux réglementaires ou opérationnels. L’objectif n’est pas de construire une organisation lourde pour absorber cette croissance mais bien de trouver une meilleure façon de travailler à chaque étape.

Et à mesure que tu prends ownership du sujet, ton rôle pourra aller bien au-delà de l’exécution d’une roadmap : comprendre suffisamment bien le métier pour contribuer directement aux prochains sujets sur lesquels Bricks doit investir.

L'offre

👉 CDI, temps plein.

👉 De vrais sujets, un vrai impact : produit régulé, vraies conséquences quand on se plante.

👉 Beaucoup d’ownership : tu travailleras directement avec les personnes qui font le produit et tu auras une vraie influence sur ce qu’on construit.

👉Une boîte ambitieuse, rentable et en forte croissance : tu arrives à un moment où l’organisation Product est encore suffisamment petite pour que tu puisses réellement contribuer à la construire.

👉 Salaire compétitif, assurance santé moderne, MacBook Pro de ton choix, tout le matériel qu'il te faut.

👉 Hybride Montpellier : office-first (2j/sem de remote) ou remote-first (~2j/mois au bureau).

Déroulement des entretiens

  1. Pré-qualification téléphonique avec notre recruteuse
  2. Echange métier (1h)
  3. Entretien team-fit (1h)
  4. Rencontre avec Cédric, notre fondateur (45 min)
  5. Offre

jobs.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

Sowefund est la plateforme pionnière et leader en France du co-investissement Venture Capital en France.

Sowefund appartient au groupe VC : Founders Future, fonds franco-américain tier-1 fondé par Marc Ménasé.Nous appliquons les mêmes standards d'analyse et de sélectivité qu'un fonds de VC institutionnel, tout en démocratisant l'accès à l'investissement early-stage auprès de +160 000 investisseurs particuliers.

QUELQUES CHIFFRES :

  • +10 ans d'existence
  • +250 startups financées par le groupe Founders Future x Sowefund, parmi elles : Mon Petit Placement, Lydia, Yuka, ekWateur, Lunii, Bitstack, Veesion, Entent, Campsider...
  • +150M€ levés pour nos entreprises
  • ~30 deals/an du pre-seed à la Series B (tickets de 500K€ à 5M€)+30 verticales d'investissement B2C et B2B : Climate Tech, HealthTech, Mobility, Fintech, Foodtech, Spacetech, Deeptech, E-commerce, Retail, Agritech, Cybersecurity, Edtech, Industrie 4.0...

NOTRE MISSION :

Pour les fondateurs des meilleures startups européennes : Apporter un double levier unique → des tickets allant jusqu'à 5M€ + du smart money via une communauté de 160K investisseurs engagés qui deviennent ambassadeurs de leur marque (visibilité, business development, réseau, acquisition…).

Pour les investisseurs : Démocratiser l'accès aux meilleures startups européennes, du pre-seed à la pre-IPO, aux mêmes conditions d'investissement que les fonds institutionnels.

NOTRE AMBISSION :

Devenir la plateforme de référence européenne de co-investissement dans le Venture Capital. Concrètement : Expansion européenne, multiplication des projets financés, et positionnement du co-investissement retail comme un standard aux côtés des fonds institutionnels.

Vos missions

TA MISSION :

Envie de plonger au cœur de l’écosystème startup et de participer concrètement à des levées de fonds ? Rejoins notre équipe Fundraising Program et accompagne des fondateurs ambitieux dans des moments clés de leur développement.

Tu piloteras plusieurs campagnes de levée de fonds de A à Z : de la préparation des supports jusqu’au lancement du closing, en passant par le suivi de la collecte de fonds.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS :

  • Préparer les supports clés de campagne : pitch, one-pager, business plan et rédaction des fiches d’investissement.
  • Onboarder et conseiller les fondateurs : cadrage de la stratégie de levée, définition des enjeux et mise en place du rétroplanning de campagne.
  • Piloter la collecte : suivi des performances, organisation de points hebdomadaires et reporting.
  • Animer la campagne : participation à l’organisation de webinaires / sessions de pitch.

Vos compétences

Étudiant(e) Bac+4/5 (école de commerce ou université), avec un fort intérêt pour la startup, la finance et l’innovation

  • Rigoureux(se), organisé(e) et à l’aise avec la gestion de plusieurs projets en parallèle (Une première expérience en gestion de projet est un plus).
  • Bonnes bases en finance et compréhension de base des mécanismes d’une levée de fonds.
  • Excellentes capacités de communication écrite et orale.
  • Curieux(se), autonome, avec une vraie envie d’apprendre au contact direct des fondateurs.

Avantages

Une immersion concrète dans l’univers des startups et du financement ;

  • Des responsabilités dès le premier jour, avec un réel impact ;
  • Une montée en compétences rapide à la croisée de la finance, du conseil et de l’entrepreneuriat ;
  • Une équipe jeune et dynamique.

MODALITÉS DU STAGE :

  • Durée : 6 mois
  • Date de début : Janvier 2027
  • Tickets restaurant / 50% pass navigo
  • Process rapide :
  1. First call (15-20 minutes)
  2. Case study
  3. C-level call

jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within Doit's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
