ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions.

  • Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market.

  • Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour.

  • Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

About the Team

The Data Science team builds the AI models behind Beamery's Data Foundry, the common data and AI layer powering all Beamery products, and works hand in hand with the product teams to empower their features with AI (such as Talent Match and recommendations). At the heart of our work is the Beamery taxonomy, the language of work (skills, role titles and tasks) that every Beamery product speaks, built on more than a decade of research and kept current by the Taxonomist, our agentic system, so it reflects the real pulse of the job market. We combine LLMs, Transformers and embedding models with classic machine learning, always choosing the best balance between quality, latency and cost.

We see ourselves as pioneers in AI for HR Tech: in 2026 the team finished 1st in the industry track and 2nd overall out of 40 teams at the ACM RecSys Challenge.

About the Role

You will join the team as a Senior Data Scientist and own our matching, recommendation and taxonomy mapping models, working closely with the product engineering teams that bring them to our customers. You will be responsible for the full cycle of your work, from defining how quality is measured and designing the models to running robust scientific experiments, tracking technical and business metrics, and writing and reviewing code. You will also advise the product teams on how to implement AI features with an evaluation-first mindset, and keep pushing the boundaries of Beamery's AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build, improve and own our matching and recommendation models (e.g. candidate to job matching, internal mobility recommendations etc.).

  • Apply an evaluation-first mindset: build golden datasets from real recruiter and user decisions, define quality metrics, design and run robust scientific experiments, track and report both technical and business metrics (using LLM-as-a-judge and human feedback), and communicate results and metrics clearly to the product teams.

  • Write clean and tested Python code using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Codex), and review code with care, both from your peers and from AI agents, so the team's codebase stays consistent, readable and safe.

  • Follow recent research (e.g. LLMs, embeddings, recommender systems, explainability, model evaluation) and bring the most relevant ideas into our product roadmap.

  • Document your work and present it clearly to product, engineering and business stakeholders, and contribute to the team's research visibility (such as challenges, conferences and publications).

Required Skills and Experience

  • A minimum of 2-4 years of experience as a Data Scientist, Senior Data Scientist (or a similar role) in an AI startup or an AI team, with a dynamic environment and a variety of use cases.

  • Strong experience with recommender systems, search, ranking or matching (e.g. learning-to-rank, scoring models, Gradient Boosting Trees, embedding models).

  • Fluency in evaluation: designing datasets and quality metrics (such as AUC, NDCG, precision and recall), and using LLM-as-a-judge and human feedback.

  • A strong foundation in NLP and GenAI, including Transformers, LLMs and embedding models (training or fine-tuning them is a strong plus).

  • High-quality software development skills in Python (clean design, testing, packaging, maintainable code etc.), practical knowledge of CI/CD, and hands-on experience with agentic coding, with the judgement to know when AI-generated code is right or wrong.

  • The ability to simplify complex problems, to work with ambiguity, and to collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business stakeholders.

  • A Master's degree or PhD, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with explainable or conversational recommendations.

  • Experience in HR Tech, talent acquisition or workforce data.

  • Publications, open-source contributions or strong results in ML challenges (e.g. RecSys, Kaggle).

What We Offer

  • The chance to own core AI models that are used by some of the world's most forward-thinking organisations.

  • A team that publishes, competes and is recognised in the research community, while shipping real products.

  • Work with the latest AI technologies and tools, including AI coding agents as part of the daily workflow.

  • Close collaboration with experienced data scientists, QA, platform and product engineers.

jobs.title: AI Native Account Executive, Compute
jobs.description:
fal is the generative media ecosystem powering the next generation of AI products. We build the infrastructure, tools, and model access that teams need to move from idea to production, and do it at scale without compromise. For developers and enterprises, fal is the foundation that makes generative media not just possible, but practical: a unified platform where high-performance inference, orchestration, and observability come together to unlock new categories of AI-native products.

As generative media reshapes industries across a market projected to grow by hundreds of billions over the next decade, fal is becoming the ecosystem that ambitious teams build on.

About fal

fal is the generative media platform for developers. We give the world's most ambitious AI teams the fastest way to run image, video, audio and 3D models in production. We also provide the GPU infrastructure they need to train, fine-tune and serve models of their own.

Our inference engine was built from the ground up for generative media. It has made fal the platform builders reach for when speed, scale and reliability matter. Our customers range from the fastest-growing AI companies in the world to the Fortune 500. More and more of them are coming to us for raw compute as well as inference and model APIs.

We're a small, high-output team, and we're growing fast. If you want to be in the room while the infrastructure layer of generative AI gets built, this is that room.

About the Role

As an Account Executive on our Compute team, you'll own new-logo acquisition across AI-native startups and neolabs. You'll sell fal's full compute offering: dedicated GPU clusters, reserved and on-demand capacity, and the inference platform that developers already build on. This is a pure hunter role. You won't inherit a book. You'll build one, and with it you'll help define how fal takes compute to market.

What You'll Do

Build and own your pipeline

  • Own all net-new logo acquisition across a defined set of AI-native startups, neolabs and research-driven model builders.

  • Build pipeline from scratch through founder and investor networks, targeted outbound, community and events, and the market signals that tell you a team is about to need compute: a fresh fundraise, a new model release, a hiring spree in research.

  • Use fal's product data to spot developers and teams already building on our platform whose usage shows they're ready for a larger compute commitment.

  • Keep a focused, prioritized target list. Know which 30 companies matter most this quarter and why.

Lead technical, consultative sales cycles

  • Engage founders, CTOs, heads of research and infrastructure leads early, often before a formal buying process exists.

  • Run deep discovery on each customer's workloads: training vs. fine-tuning vs. inference, model architecture and scale, GPU generation and cluster topology, storage and networking, utilization targets and timeline.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering on benchmarks, proofs of concept and architecture reviews that show fal's performance and reliability on the customer's own workloads.

  • Translate technical requirements into a clear business case: time-to-cluster, price-performance, flexibility and total cost.

Structure and close compute deals

  • Design commercial agreements that fit how fast-growing AI companies actually operate: reserved clusters, on-demand and burst capacity, prepaid commitments, and blended platform agreements.

  • Work with our capacity, finance and deal desk teams to secure supply and structure deals that work for both the customer and fal.

  • Run the full cycle from first conversation through negotiation and signature, keeping momentum through commercial, technical and legal review.

Grow with your customers

  • Land with an initial workload, then expand as customers scale from experimentation to large training runs to production inference.

  • Build multi-threaded relationships so fal is the first call when a customer's next capacity need appears.

  • Hand off smoothly and stay aligned with Account Management and Customer Success as accounts mature.

Shape the business

  • Bring structured customer and market feedback to Product, Infrastructure and Leadership: what's winning, what's missing, and what competitors are doing.

  • Help build the playbook. You'll be among the first sellers dedicated to this segment, and your input will shape how the motion scales.

  • Keep forecasting accurate and pipeline up to date in Salesforce.

  • 5+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience, with a consistent record of meeting or beating quota in a closing role.

  • 2+ years selling cloud infrastructure, GPU compute, AI/ML platforms or developer tools. You've sold technical products to technical buyers and you're fluent in the conversation.

  • Startup and AI-native buyers are your home turf. You understand how funding cycles, runway and competitive pressure drive buying, and you know how to move at their pace.

  • Technical credibility. You can hold a real conversation with an ML engineer or research lead about GPU generations, interconnect, cluster sizing, training vs. inference economics, and why utilization matters. You don't need to be an engineer, but engineers should be glad you're on the call.

  • A builder's approach to pipeline. You've generated a large share of your own pipeline and you're energized, not intimidated, by a blank territory.

  • Strong commercial judgment. You know when a long-term reservation is the right answer for a customer and when flexibility matters more. You structure deals that set customers up to grow.

  • Low ego, high ownership. You collaborate closely with Solutions Engineering, Product and Finance, and you take accountability for outcomes.

  • Experience at a GPU cloud, neocloud, hyperscaler startup team, or AI infrastructure company

Product Manager - Trust & Safety (Full Remote - Netherlands)
jobs.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We are looking for a Trust & Safety Product Manager to own the product and technical delivery of our compliance and safety initiatives across our platforms.

You will turn safety requirements into effective product features, moderation capabilities, third-party integrations, and measurable improvements. Working closely with Compliance, Engineering, AI/ML, Product, and Customer Support, you will help us identify risks earlier, build safeguards into new features, and continuously improve how our safety systems perform.

This is a newly created role within our Product team, working directly with our CTO, Michael Monin and our Legal & Safety Lead, Maxwelle Sokol. You will have significant ownership from the outset and the opportunity to shape how the safety product function develops as the company continues to grow.

Our platform serves adults and permits lawful adult content. We are looking for someone who can navigate sensitive, context-dependent issues thoughtfully, protecting users and enforcing clear boundaries without unnecessarily restricting legitimate expression.

Here’s what you can expect:

Key Responsibilities

  • Safety & legal product strategy and delivery. Translate safety policies, legal requirements (e.g., in online safety and AI-specific laws such as the EU AI Act), incident findings, and user feedback into clear product requirements, acceptance criteria, and engineering work. Drive initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and ongoing improvement.

  • Internally developed moderation technologies. Own the product side of improvements to our in-house moderation systems, including our proprietary LLM technology EverGuard. Partner with Engineering and AI/ML teams on, e.g., detection capabilities, moderation rules and thresholds, and appropriate interventions across user inputs and AI-generated outputs.

  • Third-party safety partnerships and integrations. Lead the technical and product lifecycle of third-party safety partnerships, from identifying needs and evaluating providers to implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing performance management.

  • Safety dashboards, monitoring, and quality assurance. Establish dashboards and a recurring QA that help us proactively identify emerging issues, prevent harmful content, and ensure that our T&S measures are working as intended.

  • Red teaming and adversarial testing. Own our testing for how moderation systems and product safeguards respond to deliberate misuse and difficult edge cases. Track findings through remediation, retesting, and closure—not just delivery of a report.

  • Trust and safety reviews for new features. Establish and run a dedicated T&S review for new features, with proportionate reviews for material changes to existing features, models, and integrations. Engage early in product design to identify foreseeable misuse, affected users, and appropriate safeguards.

  • Incident follow-through and continuous improvement. Coordinate the product and engineering response to significant safety issues, working with colleagues responsible for incident management, policy, and user support.

Learn more about our Trust & Safety infrastructure in our Trust & Safety Hub.

Your Qualifications

  • Data-driven product decisions that align with legal/ethical standards: You can name the metrics you want to influence, explain why it matters, and say whether your work actually moved them. You’ve run A/B tests, product experiments, data deep-dives, or lightweight user research and used the findings to shape what was built next. You can assess risks associated with user-generated content, transactions, and interactions, and translate these into policies that align with legal and ethical standards, trackers/dashboards, and strategic planning;

  • Content moderation and AI guardrails: You understand how product realities and safety requirements interact on a tech platform; you explore strategies for efficient and scalable content moderation, including automation, machine learning, human review and user reporting.

  • Legal/safety work experience: You have worked closely with trust and safety and compliance requirements and understand how to translate and implement these for a consumer-facing product;

  • Collaborative mindset and communication: You work cross-functionally with engineering, legal, operations, and customer support teams — these are your partners and support system, not your adversaries or a box to be checked. You ask the right questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and are fully fluent and comfortable in English;

  • AI fluency: You are completely comfortable working with and leveraging AI tools. You actively seek out and experiment with new tools and techniques without waiting for a project or manager to require them;

  • You are point person for third-party partnerships: You proactively test and can autonomously handle discussions with third-party tools and integrations that affect our compliance and safety posture;

  • You take ownership and move without waiting for certainty: Comfortable with ambiguity, you create clarity by investigating, building, testing, and learning rather than waiting for a complete brief. You balance execution against planning, address blockers early, and take responsibility for the outcome rather than waiting to be told what to do, caring more about reaching the right result than following a fixed process;

  • You are comfortable with the product category: you are fully comfortable building products based on uncensored models and content;

Bonus points

  • You have previous legal/compliance education

  • Professional experience or interest in AI

  • Experience with consumer-facing features, particularly in the entertainment or gaming industry

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable reviewing and discussing uncensored AI-generated content and NSFW material

We believe strongly that information can be learned, but effort and motivation cannot. If this role appeals to you but you don’t have hands-on experience in all the fields listed in this job description, apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a good fit!

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: $95K – $125K

(Senior) Flight Control System Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Quantum Systems, we are redefining the boundaries of autonomous drone technology. We develop and deploy some of the world’s most advanced UAVs with vertical takeoff and landing capability. The autopilot software components, including the flight control system, are developed and maintained completely in-house to optimally match the complex, fast-changing requirements of the modern world of unmanned systems.​

As a Senior Flight Control System Engineer, you will hold a key position within our Flight Control Team, working at the intersection of real-world UAV systems, flight control theory, algorithm development, software implementation, verification and validation. ​

Between intense whiteboard sessions to conceptualize the next groundbreaking solution, focused implementation of algorithms, simulation testing, iterations, flight test, flight data analysis and documentation, you will be working at the very core of our system.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Conceptualize effective and safe flight control solutions to complex multi-domain problems concerning flight stability, performance and safety​.

  • Participate in shaping flight control system architecture and interface design decisions to ensure continuous scalability and flexibility of the flight control software and other autopilot components​.

  • Help coordinate and optimize the team‘s workflow between concept reviews, implementation, code reviews, simulation and flight testing, log data analysis and documentation​.

  • Communicate and coordinate with other stakeholders across team boundaries such as test pilots, product managers, software and hardware developers of all other UAV and ground system components​.

  • Maintain continuous overview over flight operations, prototype operations and testing results to identify possible problems and solutions.


What you bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Flight Control System design, preferably both multirotor and fixed wing control​.

  • Intuitive, internalized understanding of flight physics and flight dynamics.

  • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with control theory and controller implementation​.

  • Strong proficiency in Matlab/Simulink .

  • Experience writing and analyzing C/C++ Code​.

  • Knowledge and hands-on experience with digital signal processing and data analysis​.

  • Ability to work within and across highly specialized teams, efficiently communicate and coordinate.

Why Quantum-Systems:

  • We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

  • We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

  • We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

  • We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.


Our benefits:

  • Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later.

  • Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

  • Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance.

  • Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

  • Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy.

  • Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

  • Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

  • Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

  • Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.


About us:

Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors.


Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist
jobs.description:
Sécheron Hasler Group is a global leader in railway and industrial electrification systems, offering cutting-edge solutions to enhance transportation and decarbonize industrial processes. With a rich heritage of over a century and a commitment to innovation, Sécheron Hasler Group is growing worldwide.

For the Electrical Safety Solutions (ESS) Business Unit, we are looking for an experienced marketing professional with a strong interest in technical products and industrial markets. The Senior Product Marketing & Exhibitions Specialist will translate ESS business priorities and product value propositions into clear marketing communications, sales tools, product training and customer-facing materials. The candidate will work closely with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers, Sales and the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.

Global objectives:

  • Drive the execution of the ESS marketing plan and business growth priorities, in cooperation with the Business Development Manager, Product Line Managers and Sales.
  • Develop and maintain marketing and sales materials for existing and new products and applications.
  • Develop product marketing communication using various communication channels to promote ESS and its respective products.
  • Work with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team for trade shows/fairs and manage the required preparation and coordination with the respective Business Unit teams.
  • Provide marketing inputs and product communication materials to support Product Line Managers and Sales.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver marketing communication plans based on ESS business priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager.
  • Contribute to product launch plans defined with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers; coordinate the preparation and delivery of marketing materials, training and communication activities
  • Develop marketing and sales materials, including commercial brochures, PowerPoint presentations, promotional videos and animations for products and applications, and website content.
  • Collect and structure market and competitor information; prepare customer-oriented product messages, competitive comparisons and sales enablement materials in collaboration with the Business Development Manager and Product Line Managers.
  • Develop product training materials with Product Line Managers and support training for the worldwide Sales network.
  • Maintain product documentation for intranet and corporate purposes.
  • Coordinate annual exhibition and trade show preparation within ESS, based on priorities agreed with the Business Development Manager and Sales, and in alignment with the Sécheron Hasler Group Marketing Team.
  • Develop marketing concepts, communication campaigns, exhibition experiences, templates and customer engagement initiatives aligned with ESS business priorities.
  • Contribute to the annual ESS strategy review by preparing marketing performance indicators, communication plans and supporting materials.
  • Support the continuous improvement of ESS sales enablement tools and materials, helping ensure that Sales teams have up-to-date product messaging, training and communication.

Requirements

  • Further education in industrial product marketing
  • Degree in marketing, communications, business or a technical field; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
  • Ability to understand electronic products and translate technical information into clear customer-facing content.
  • Solid experience in marketing communications, product marketing or sales enablement in an international industrial B2B environment.
  • Experience creating marketing materials for technical products and collaborating with Sales, Product Management or Engineering teams.
  • Experience coordinating projects and stakeholders across different countries or functions.
  • Experience in product marketing, marketing communications or sales enablement for technical products.
  • Good knowledge of at least one of the following industry sectors: high voltage, railway traction systems, power transmission & distribution, renewable energy and e-mobility.
  • Interest and ability to understand DC and AC power systems and corresponding product needs.
  • Excellent project management, organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate technical information into clear marketing messages and customer benefits.
  • Proven ability to think creatively, identify and resolve problems.
  • Experienced to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
  • Proficiency in MS-Office programs.

Benefits

We foster flat hierarchies and direct communication, enabling quick decisions and strong collaboration across all levels. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility and encouraged to take initiative, with plenty of opportunities to grow both personally and professionally.

By combining growth analytics, performance modeling, and full-stack engineering, we own the end-to-end acquisition funnel – from the very first touchpoint to a completed loan application. Our Core Focus:

Strategic Growth & Analytics: We serve as the central hub for our Direct Marketing and Sales channels. We translate complex data into actionable strategies, ensuring our outreach is both scalable and profitably managed.

Technical Infrastructure: We build and maintain the proprietary systems and models that drive our German operations. This includes optimizing the "User Experience" (UX) to ensure a frictionless onboarding process for small businesses.

Operational Excellence: We connect the dots between data-driven decision-making and real-world commercial impact. Our mission is to ensure every potential customer receives a clear, relevant, and rapid understanding of how iwoca can fund their business.

We are a fast-moving, cross-functional unit designed to turn strategic hypotheses into measurable results. Whether it’s refining a marketing model or shipping a new feature in the application journey, we ensure that iwoca’s expansion in the German market is backed by robust tech and a clear commercial North Star.

The role

This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, data, and technology. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will lead a high-performing, interdisciplinary team of three and own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market. Your primary objective is to co-define the growth strategy and partner closely with engineering and data teams to build the systems, onboarding journeys, and experiments that bring that strategy to life.

The scope of this role is broad and we're not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning strategy, analytics, product development, and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

You'll define hypotheses, lead cross-functional initiatives, and own the roadmap for how iwoca engages with German businesses. You will be accountable for measurable impact on acquisition and conversion, bringing ideas to life through rigorous commercial insight, strong customer empathy, and practical delivery. As a Lead, you will also be responsible for coaching your team and establishing the operating rhythm for this new unit.

Market and problem understanding

  • Deeply understand the German SME lending landscape, customer needs, and competitive context to sharpen our go-to-market strategy.
  • Translate market and customer insight into clearly defined product problems and prioritised commercial opportunities.
  • Inform targeting and segmentation strategies to help Marketing and Sales reach the right customers.

Product build and optimisation

  • Own the roadmap for acquisition and onboarding, working with engineers and data scientists to develop tools such as lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers, and onboarding journeys.
  • Work with marketing and sales to evolve website content, sign-up flows, and decisioning logic to increase conversion.
  • Influence future team capability by helping define priorities, roles, and processes as we scale.

Experimentation and insight

  • Design, run, and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, onboarding tools, and product flows.
  • Identify opportunities using first-principle reasoning supported by data, customer research, and funnel analysis.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of at the beginning two commercial strategy analysts and a data scientist focused on acquisition strategy and operational excellence.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning engineering, data, marketing, and commercial stakeholders around clear goals, hypotheses, and success metrics.
  • Translate high-level business goals into testable hypotheses and actionable briefs for our technical teams.
  • Help establish the operating rhythm, rituals, and roadmap processes for this new team.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Strong commercial mindset with proven experience driving go-to-market strategy and measurable acquisition growth.
  • Experience in growth strategy, revenue operations, or a highly analytical commercial role with a track record of driving tech-enabled or product-led growth.
  • Proven people management or team leadership experience, with the ability to build culture and establish operating rhythms in a newly formed team.
  • Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments.
  • Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.
  • Experience working with (or a strong desire to learn about) technical models such as lead scoring, predictive targeting, or qualification logic.
  • Ability to work from first principles and thrive in ambiguity with curiosity and autonomy.

Bonus:

  • Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products.
  • Experience working closely with engineering, product, or data science teams to ship features or models.
  • Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.
  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with ridiculous growth-mindset.

26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

Company Pension with Canada Life.

Corporate Benefits discounts.

’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager Benelux
jobs.description:
Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform driving digital commerce across the globe. By offering a fully integrated solution, we empower marketers, online stores, and digital agencies to manage, scale, and optimize their online activities.

As the market leader in the Benelux, we owe our success to an incredible product, a passionate team ánd our customers who love working with us! To keep winning, our Benelux region is split into two specialized teams (Strategic and Growth), working closely together.  This opening is within the CS Benelux Strategic team.

Your role in a nutshell: you'll own Channable's most strategic Benelux relationships: (inter)national brands with digital marketing teams in the region, and our biggest Agency Partners (Gold & Silver). You'll work with senior specialists, marketing leads, heads of e-commerce, and decision-makers to understand what their business is trying to achieve this year and how their digital marketing team is measured against it. From there, you find where Channable can drive the outcomes that get them closer to those goals. When your clients win, and Channable is a part of that, we grow together, and that growth is yours to own.


Here's what that looks like day-to-day:

  • Business-goal alignment and planning: understanding each client's and/or agency's annual objectives and how their digital marketing team contributes to them, then translating that into a strategic success plan with outcomes both sides can measure.

  • Stakeholder management & multi-threading: building and maintaining relationships across the whole account, from hands-on specialists to executive sponsors, so no relationship rests on a single contact.

  • Strategic cadence: kick-offs, Impact Reviews, realizing success plans with outcome-driven and goal-focused metrics, check-ins, demos, hosting trainings, and commercially led meetings, online and onsite, in the market.

  • Portfolio & account ownership: retention, expansion and net new MRR across a named set of top-tier accounts; identifying risk early, preventing churn and downgrades; pipeline creation and forecasting.

  • Voice of the customer: running trainings and enablement for large advertisers and partner teams, feeding client insight back to product and commercial, and turning your strongest accounts into webinars, success stories and references.

  • Raising the bar: contributing to how we manage the strategic segment, account plans, risk signals, expansion playbooks, and Customer Success processes.

What you bring:

  • You have 3+ years' experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Partnership Management, or a similar client-facing commercial role, with a track record on large or complex accounts. Experience on the other side of the table, at a marketing agency or in-house at a brand, counts fully.

  • You build relationships across an organisation, from hands-on specialists to senior decision-makers, and you're willing to challenge a client when their plan won't get them where they say they want to go.

  • You've carried a commercial target, and you know how to plan towards it rather than hope for it.

  • You understand online marketing well enough to hold a credible conversation with a performance marketing lead.

  • Not a must, but a strong plus: experience on the client side, at a marketing agency or in an in-house digital marketing team (preferably e-commerce)

  • You have at least a completed HBO education - for example, in the direction of commercial economics, (international) business, marketing, or hospitality.

  • Your language skills include excellent written and spoken Dutch (C2)  and English at a C1 level.

Other requirements:

  • You are living in The Netherlands with travel distance from our Utrecht office.

  • You are willing to come to our Utrecht office for 2 days/week, preferably more.

  • You are available to travel and visit clients.

  • You are available for at least 32 hours per week (4 days).

  • You have a valid work permit for the Netherlands or EU citizenship.

  • Not a must, but a strong plus: experience on the client side, at a marketing agency or in an in-house digital marketing team (preferably e-commerce)

Who are we?

Being part of our team means working with diverse and fun people who trust and help you along the way. Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, more than +40 nationalities, and a brand new and vibrant HQ in Utrecht, serving customers all over the globe. We're also operating from other offices including New York City, Berlin, and Aarhus.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. We like spending time with each other. Be that in the office, our Channabar, or in one of our internal chats. We’re open-minded and down-to-earth people. We’re super proud that everyone adds their own special spice to Channable’s culture. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at our Instagram, Facebook or LinkedIn! Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

What do we offer?

The OTE salary ranges from €3.650 to €5.000 gross per month based on a 40-hour workweek. OTE (On Target Earnings) consists of 80% gross base salary and 20% commission (paid out quarterly). A breakdown of this structure is provided below:

  • Base salary: The base salary is gross between €3.650 and €5.000 (80%) per month based on a 40-hour workweek. The salary is determined based on experience.

  • Performance bonus: 20% performance bonus is gross between €915 and €1.250 (20%) per month based on a 40-hour workweek.

  • 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with the May salary.

  • Annual L&D budget of € 1000 to spend on anything you want to learn. You can take full advantage of this to grow professionally.

  • Saving for old age - we have a saving scheme for old age which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.

  • Traveling to our office? No problem, we got you covered. (NS Business Card, or €0,25 per km if you decide to use a different means of transport) 🚆

  • Our beautiful, fully renovated historic office in central Utrecht offers a hybrid working policy, requiring just two days in the office per week.

  • Since you can work from home, we will provide home office supplies. 🖥️⌨️

  • 26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours.

  • We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks, if you live as an expat in the Netherlands! 🍹

  • Having flexible working hours means starting your day between 8.00 - 10.00 am. 🕰️

  • We want you to feel good - please feel free to use our discounted Urban Sports Club subscription.

  • You have free & anonymous access to the OpenUp platform and psychologists. This free service is also available to your family members.

  • Are you going to become a parent? We think it is important that you spend time with your newborn. Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave!

  • At Channable, our Chef and Commis Chef prepare fresh meals Monday to Thursday, catering to all dietary needs - including vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free - to keep our team fueled and inspired! To round out the week, Fridays feature delicious ordered-in sandwiches and salads. Or, you can go to the city center to get the lunch of your choice.

  • Channaweekend - Every year we go for a long weekend with all our colleagues from all over the world. 💜🔥

  • Channaweek - We believe in bringing people together. That’s why we organize global events like Channaweek where our entire international team gathers in Utrecht to connect and learn from one another.

  • Additional working conditions like massages, in-office bar (Channabar), parties, even personal training sessions at our Channagym, video games, and many more!

How can you introduce yourself to us?

Are you interested? Please apply by clicking on the "apply now" button below. Please send your application in English.

Interview steps:

  1. If it's a match, our Talent Acquisition Team will get in touch with you for an introduction call (25 minutes).

  2. After that, you’ll be invited for an interview with Jules (your future team lead) & one of the other team leads of the Customer Success department (60 minutes).

  3. Next, you'll have an assignment interview with Jules (your future team lead) & Io at our Utrecht office. You’ll also receive an office tour from your future team members (90 minutes).

  4. Please note that after the interviews and before the offer stage, we’ll conduct reference checks.

We consider applications as they come in. We look forward to hearing from you!

*Contact by job agencies and recruiters will not be appreciated. Each recruiter or headhunter who approaches us agrees with a donation of €250 for Make-A-Wish.

**At Channable, we strive to create and foster an environment of belonging and collaboration. We believe in diverse and inclusive teams.

We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our London office.

  • Design sophisticated workflows and relational data structures within the monday.com platform to solve complex business cases, partnering with technical resources for data conversions, integrations, and agentic engineering.

  • Actively leverage monday AI and external Generative/Agentic AI tools to accelerate solution design, automate complex business logic, and deliver intelligent workflows for our customers.

  • Act as the project manager on standalone engagements, building and executing on project plans that ensure deliverables stay on-time and on-budget, and delivering defined scope alongside a deployment strategist on larger ones.

jobs.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

Smart Impulse c'est l'histoire d'un projet de fin d'études qui se transforme en un projet entrepreneurial ambitieux et engagé !

C'est en 2011 que Charles et Henri, nos deux fondateurs, se lancent le défi de révolutionner la gestion de l'Énergie dans les bâtiments.

Plus concrètement, nous concevons et développons des solutions de mesure électrique nouvelle génération avec un compteur électrique, le Smart X, simple à installer (moins d'une heure, sans outil et sans coupure), permettant, à partir d'un seul point de mesure et d'algorithmes brevetés (Nonintrusive Load Monitoring - NILM), d'identifier la consommation de chaque type d'équipements dans un bâtiment (éclairage, chauffage, informatique, ventilation, etc.).

L'analyse des données récoltées permet aux gestionnaires de bâtiments tertiaires d'identifier des leviers d'économie et ainsi maîtriser et optimiser la consommation d'énergie.

Aujourd'hui, nos solutions sont déployées dans plus de 4000 bâtiments répartis dans 60 pays dans le monde.

Rejoignez notre équipe de plus de 60 Impulsers qui participent au quotidien à façonner l'avenir de l'innovation énergétique !

LE CONTEXTE

Afin d'accélérer notre croissance, nous recherchons un·e Ingénieur·e Logiciel Embarqué pour nous permettre de lancer le développement de la prochaine génération de notre compteur intelligent - avec l'ambition de faire du hardware un avantage concurrentiel durable pour Smart Impulse.

Rattaché·e au Hardware Manager, au sein de la Feature Team Hardware composée d'un manager hands-on (Mathieu, votre futur responsable) et d'un Ingénieur Logiciel Embarqué (Gordon), vous contribuerez principalement au développement logiciel de la prochaine génération de notre compteur.

À partir d'une page quasi blanche, l'enjeu sera de concevoir un compteur permettant de proposer des solutions toujours plus adaptées aux besoins de nos clients, alignées avec les market standards (self-service, métrologie, cybersécurité, certifications, gestion de flotte, etc.) et d'augmenter les capacités de nos algorithmes (Edge AI).

VOS MISSIONS

Au quotidien, vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

Conception logicielle

  • Participer à la définition de la nouvelle génération de compteurs intelligents
  • Concevoir des architectures logicielles fiables reposant sur votre expertise passée (découpage en couches, machines à états, design patterns, etc.)

Développement logiciel embarqué

  • Développer le logiciel embarqué de la nouvelle génération de compteurs intelligents sur cible microcontrôleur
  • Maintenir et enrichir les tests unitaires nécessaires à la qualité du développement logiciel (CI/CD, pipelines)
  • Participer aux revues techniques intra-équipe
  • Participer ponctuellement au support des produits existants (Smart X, routeurs OpenWRT)

Développement software et outils

  • Contribuer au développement des outils que la Feature Team met à disposition des autres équipes
  • Développer les outils nécessaires aux tests qualité et à la mise en production de nos produits (bancs de production)

Documentation

  • Rédiger des documentations internes claires au niveau de détail approprié (README, changelog, base de connaissance, Merge Request, communications internes) en lien avec vos développements logiciels
  • Suivre et mettre à jour les tickets de développement sur lesquels vous travaillez

NOS OUTILS ET TECHNOLOGIES

Outils

  • Développement : Jira, Git/GitLab
  • Monitoring et data : Grafana, Dataiku, Metabase
  • LLM : Claude (Claude Code), CodeRabbit (revue de code)

Technologies

  • Cibles hardware : MCU ARM, STM32, ESP
  • Développement embarqué : C/C++, Rust, ESP-IDF, Python
  • Temps réel : FreeRTOS
  • Connectivité : Wi-Fi/LAN, 4G
  • Langages d'outils/scripts : Python / Bash
  • Backend : Python (Django)

L'IMPULSEUR·EUSE QU'IL NOUS FAUT

Formation & Expérience

  • Bac +5 ou supérieur, école d'ingénieurs ou filière universitaire
  • Vous avez un minimum de 5 années d'expérience et justifiez d'une expérience réussie sur du développement logiciel embarqué sur cible microcontrôleur, idéalement dans un environnement start-up/scale-up

jobs.description:

Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

  • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

  • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Recruitment Flow
  • Recruiter Interview
  • First Technical Interview
  • Coding / AI assisted coding interview
  • Mobile System Design Interview
  • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
  • Offer

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

We would like the new colleague to start as soon as possible. Interested? Apply via the button below with your CV and a short motivation. For questions, please contact Veroniek Smits, our Corporate Recruiter, at

jobs.title: Project manager (Senior)
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren project manager die impact wil maken binnen een snelgroeiend softwarebedrijf? Wil jij het verschil maken bij klanten op het gebied van personeelsplanning en personeelskrapte? Heb jij de kennis en vaardigheden om projecten efficiënt te managen en tegelijkertijd de klanttevredenheid hoog te houden? Wil jij jouw ervaring inzetten om het team te versterken en samen optimale resultaten te behalen? Dan kijken we ernaar uit om je te ontmoeten!  
 
Werken bij een van de Top 3 spelers in Workforce management in Nederland en bijdragen aan snelle ontwikkeling in het buitenland? 
Bij Intus helpen wij onze klanten en hun medewerkers met slimmer plannen. Hierdoor dragen we bij aan het oplossen van één van de belangrijkste maatschappelijke uitdagingen: personeelskrapte. 

Onze producten brengen flexibiliteit en efficiëntie in het planningsproces en dat is fijn voor iedereen. Onze klanten kunnen onze medewerkers optimaal inzetten, terwijl we tegelijkertijd bijdragen aan meer werkgeluk en een gezonde werk-privé balans. Een win-win voor iedereen! 
 
Als project manager bij Intus speel je een cruciale rol in projecten bij onze diverse klanten in verschillende markten zoals zorg, overheid, industrie en logistiek. Je structureert en realiseert meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd van begin tot het eind. Dit kan gaan om het begeleiden van onze klanten bij het volledig implementeren van onze software InPlanning bij een nieuwe klant of het begeleiden van een complexe transformatie in het applicatielandschap bij een bestaande klant. Ook interne projecten kunnen onderdeel van de werkzaamheden zijn. Dankzij jouw vermogen om draagvlak te creëren en overzicht te behouden, help je klanten en zorg je voor een efficiënt verloop van de projecten.  
 
Je maakt deel uit van een team van project managers en consultants die verantwoordelijk zijn voor alle projecten in Nederland. Als project manager ben jij tijdens een project hét aanspreekpunt voor de klant, met betrekking tot de voortgang, planning, kwaliteit, budget en uitvoering. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s (o.a. implementatie consultants en technisch consultants) om de projecten te realiseren, en daarnaast heb je ook regelmatig contact met je collega-project managers, accountmanagers, technisch consultants en product owners. Kortom, een boeiende functie in een dynamische werkomgeving!  

 
Als project manager begeleidt je projecten van A tot Z wat betekent dat je de volgende verantwoordelijkheden hebt:  

  • Opstellen van een Plan van Aanpak en een implementatieagenda.  

  • Plannen van projectwerkzaamheden van consultants.  

  • Zorgdragen voor een goede samenwerking tussen alle interne en externe stakeholders van het project.  

  • Tijdig signaleren en rapporteren van risico's, op basis waarvan je een concrete aanpak voorstelt op basis waarvan besluitvorming kan plaatsvinden.  

  • Bewaken van kaders waaronder projectdoelen, kwaliteit, budgetten en planningen.  

  • Verzorgen van maandrapportages en voorbereiding van de facturatie richting de klant.  

  • Overzicht behouden over meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd.  


  • Je hebt uitgebreide werkervaring als project manager, bij voorkeur in de gezondheidszorg.

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding.  

  • Je hebt een pro-actieve werkhouding en neemt verantwoordelijkheid.  

  • Je bent een echte teamspeler en weet hoe je effectief stakeholders kunt betrekken.  

  • Je werkt gestructureerd en hebt een helikopterview.  

  • Je bent resultaatgericht, maar verliest de kwaliteit niet uit het oog.  

  • Je bent gedreven, slim, analytisch en bent in staat op verschillende niveaus te denken en te handelen.  

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal op professioneel niveau, mondeling en schriftelijk. Beheers je daarnaast ook nog Duits? Dan is dat de kers op de taart! 

  

Bij Intus hechten we veel waarde aan een informele, maar professionele werksfeer. Maar er is meer dat ons bijzonder maakt! Hier is ons DNA in een kort overzicht:  

  • Trots; op ons product, onze klanten én onze collega’s!   

  • Goede vibe; een gezellige sfeer waar iedere mening telt.   

  • Open cultuur; jazeker, met korte lijnen en weinig hiërarchie.   

  • Collegialiteit; we helpen elkaar en hebben lol met elkaar. Heb je een last-minute vraag? Je vindt altijd iemand die wil helpen.   

  • Ambitieus; wat we tot nu toe hebben gedaan is geweldig, maar we zijn nog lang niet klaar!   

  

En verder bieden we:   

  • Een goed salaris

  • Een zinvolle baan: deel uitmaken van een organisatie die het werkleven van 200.000 mensen gemakkelijker maakt  

  • Gratis lunch en fruit: we eten allemaal gezamenlijk als je op kantoor bent

  • Een douche (een warme 😊)... zodat je met de fiets naar kantoor kunt komen of tijdens de lunch of na kantoortijd een stukje kunt hardlopen!  

  • 28 vakantiedagen om je batterij weer op te laden
