jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About us

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

 

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

 

The role

We're hiring Technical Program Managers in London to run Encord's highest-stakes human data projects end to end — the work for frontier AI labs and physical AI companies, in specialist domains such as medical imaging and robotics, and the data types we are running for the first time. These are the projects where the technical complexity is highest and where a mistake is expensive.

You will work at the point where machine learning requirements become annotation work: translating what a research team actually needs into workflows, standards and instructions that a specialist workforce can execute at volume, then holding the result to a measurable standard.

This is the load-bearing role in the business, and it is a hands-on one. You will know your projects' annotation standards better than anyone at the company, teach them to the annotators producing the work, decide who works on what, judge who is performing and who should come off, resolve the edge cases nobody anticipated, and answer for the delivery timeline. You will run several projects at once, and you will own how they are run.

 

What you'll do

  • Own delivery of your projects end to end — throughput, quality and timeline

  • Translate complex machine learning requirements into clear annotation workflows, and design the process that produces the data the model actually needs

  • Become the deepest expert at Encord on your project's annotation standards, and the person who resolves ambiguity and edge cases as they surface

  • Maintain quality through process refinement, auditing and structured feedback loops, rather than through inspection at the end

  • Train annotators onto the project and keep them improving — building the material yourself until our Learning & Development Specialist is in place

  • Coach your annotation teams: give them the context behind the task, not only the rules, and develop their skills as the work gets harder

  • Measure annotator performance and make the calls it implies: who continues, who needs retraining, who comes off the project

  • Allocate tasks and manage the queue so that throughput and quality targets are met together rather than traded against each other

  • Instrument the project at launch with the Quality Systems Lead — acceptance criteria, sampling plan, reviewer ratio — so it is measurable before the first batch ships

  • Produce the delivery reporting for customers, and surface risk early enough that something can still be done about it

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on process and tooling improvements, and feed recurring problems back into the playbooks, into training and into the platform

 

Who we're looking for

  • You go deep on the detail. Your instinct is to read the whole specification and annotate fifty items yourself before you assign anyone else

  • Execution-oriented: you are measured by what shipped, not by what was planned, and you would rather fix a workflow than document one

  • Analytically rigorous. You work in numbers — throughput, quality rate, utilisation — and you notice when one is being bought at the expense of another

  • Technically fluent enough to work with ML teams on what they need and why, and to pull your own data rather than wait for it

  • You make people calls on evidence rather than on impression, and you can have the difficult version of that conversation

  • Organised under real load: several projects, several time zones, and requirements that move

  • A clear writer and a strong cross-functional communicator. Most of the workforce delivering your project you will never meet in person

  • Entrepreneurial: when a date is at risk your first move is to re-plan, not to escalate, and you invent the process where none exists

  • Genuinely interested in AI and in what the data you are producing is actually for

 

Experience requirements

  • 3–7 years of professional experience, ideally combining operational delivery with analytical work — AI data or annotation operations, strategy consulting, or data and operations roles at leading technology companies

  • Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder workflows, with responsibility for the outcome rather than the coordination

  • Working proficiency in Python or SQL

  • Direct experience managing, coaching or performance-managing a distributed workforce

  • Track record of holding quality and throughput at the same time, with the numbers to show it

  • Experience translating a detailed technical specification into instructions other people can follow

  • Bonus: direct experience of annotation, evaluation or model-training workflows

 

Why Encord

  • Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup

  • Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

  • 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

  • Annual learning & development budget

  • Daily lunches and dinners

  • Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

  • Company lunches twice a week

  • Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

jobs.description:
Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Beratung

Als Project Manager übernimmst Du die Leitung von Projekten oder komplexen Teilprojekten. Deine fachliche und methodische Expertise nutzt Du zur Bearbeitung komplexer Fragestellungen und agierst als „Thought-Leader“. Neben Projekten wirkst Du an der Entwicklung unserer Services und Kompetenzen mit.

Projektmanagement

Als Experte überblickst und managst Du Projekte ganzheitlich. Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen die Planung sowie die Durchführung und Steuerung. Du übernimmst zudem die Kommunikation und Vertretung des Projektes auf Leitungsebene und nach außen.

Führungsverantwortung

Intern und auf Projekten führst Du Kollegen und Mitarbeiter. Deine Erfahrung gibst Du in Form von Coachings und Workshops weiter. Zudem teilst Du Deine Expertise in Form von Veröffentlichungen, die in Fachmedien veröffentlicht werden.

Abwechslung

Du hast Spaß daran, komplexe Problemstellungen zu strukturieren, nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln und zu deren zielgerichteter Umsetzung beizutragen. Du steuerst dabei Projektvorhaben von der Initiierung bis zur erfolgreichen Verankerung in der Organisation.

Was wir uns vor Du wünschen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftswissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Finance/Recht oder eine Ausbildung im Finanzbereich

  • Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche und im Management von Projekten

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung von (Teil-)Projekten und Projektteams

  • Qualifikation/Zertifizierung im Projektmanagement (z. B. Scrum, IPMA, PMI)

  • Nachgewiesene Expertise in mindestens einem Schwerpunktbereich (Regulatorik, Risikomanagement, Wertpapiergeschäft, IT-Management)

  • Hohe Problemlösungskompetenz und Begeisterungsfähigkeit

  • Motivation sich ständig weiterzuentwickeln und Verantwortung zu übernehmen

  • Versierter Umgang mit MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Teamplayer-Mentalität

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1)

  • Reisebereitschaft

Deine Benefits

Flexibilität: Montags und dienstags kannst Du bequem von zu Hause arbeiten, wobei Dir unser Büro dennoch jederzeit offensteht. In dringenden Fällen ist Home-Office auch an anderen Tagen möglich. Wir legen großen Wert auf persönliche Interaktionen und passen uns flexibel den Bedürfnissen unserer Kunden an.

Weiterbildung: Du hast die Freiheit, passende Trainings, Seminare und Weiterbildungen nach Deinen Präferenzen auszuwählen. Zusätzlich bieten wir interne, mitarbeitergeführte Fortbildungen und Workshops an.

Onboarding: Ab Tag 1 statten wir Dich mit einem Laptop, einem modernem Smartphone, das Du auch privat nutzen kannst, und einer Kreditkarte für Deine beruflichen Nebenkosten aus.

Coaching: Für Deine Weiterentwicklung steht Dir ein Counsellor zur Seite, mit dem Du deine persönlichen Ziele formulierst und der Dich bei der eigenen Karriereentwicklung mit seinen Erfahrungen bestmöglich unterstützt.

Gesundheit: Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen. Deshalb heißt es bei uns jeden Donnerstag: Massagetag! Ein geschulter Masseur und Osteopath kommt einmal in der Woche zu uns ins Büro. Darüber hinaus sind unsere Büros mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen ausgestattet.

Firmenevents: Freue Dich auf aufregende Teamevents und regelmäßige Get-Togethers. Von gemeinsamen Kochabenden über Formeltrainings bis hin zu Jubiläumsreisen nach London oder Malta. Diese Erlebnisse fördern den Teamgeist, schaffen gemeinsame Erfahrungen und bieten großartige Gelegenheiten, sich besser kennenzulernen.

Vergütung: Bei uns erwartet Dich ein attraktives Gehaltspaket aus festem Grundgehalt und jährlicher Bonuszahlung. Ab 5 Jahren Betriebszugehörigkeit gibt's sogar noch einen extra Bonus obendrauf!

Urlaub: 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr, um sich zu erholen und neue Energie zu tanken.

Social Responsibility: Soziales Engagement gehört für uns untrennbar zur unternehmerischen Verantwortung. Dabei stellen wir jedem Mitarbeiter ein Spendenbudget von 200€ pro Jahr zur Verfügung. Besonders am Herzen liegen uns regionale Initiativen.

Corporate Benefits: Du erhältst vergünstigte Mitarbeiterangebote auf z.B. Reisen, Mode, Technik und Veranstaltungen.

Spaß und Nervennahrung: Bei uns werden herausfordernde Arbeitstage durch packende Tischkicker-Turniere, Gespräche in der Küche und eine gesunde Dosis Vitamine aufgepeppt.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Accounting (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mach aus komplexer Buchhaltungssoftware eine, die Menschen ihre Arbeit leichter macht.

Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Dadurch sind wir direkt an den Menschen, Prozessen und Problemen, für die wir bauen.

Buchhaltung ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Arbeit. Ob Mietausschüttung, Unterkonten oder Jahresabrechnung: Abläufe müssen verständlich, Ergebnisse korrekt und Automatisierungen auch dann zuverlässig sein, wenn etwas vom Standardfall abweicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Buchhaltung tief versteht und dieses Wissen in bessere Software übersetzen kann. Gemeinsam mit unseren Nutzern, Engineering und Design findest du heraus, welche Probleme wir lösen müssen, wie eine gute Lösung aussieht und wohin sich unser Accounting-Produkt entwickeln soll.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Probleme wirklich verstehen: Du arbeitest dich in die Buchhaltungsprozesse unserer Hausverwaltungen ein – inklusive Sonderfällen, fachlichen Anforderungen und bestehender Einschränkungen.

  • Die richtigen Verbesserungen identifizieren: Du unterscheidest zwischen fehlenden Funktionen, unklaren Abläufen, technischen Fehlern und Fragen zur Bedienung.

  • Die Produktrichtung gestalten: Du entwickelst eine klare Vorstellung davon, wie Accounting bei Buena funktionieren soll, und priorisierst Verbesserungen nach Nutzen, fachlicher Notwendigkeit und Wirkung.

  • Lösungen konkret machen: Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in verständliche Konzepte, Spezifikationen und Nutzerabläufe, die du mit Engineering und Design weiterentwickelst.

  • Korrektheit sicherstellen: Du prüfst Lösungen, denkst Sonderfälle durch und beurteilst, ob neue Funktionen die zugrunde liegenden Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Bis zur Nutzung dranbleiben: Du begleitest Verbesserungen bis zur Einführung und überprüfst, ob sie das ursprüngliche Problem im Alltag lösen.

Das kann eine gezielte Verbesserung bei Mietausschüttungen sein – oder die grundlegende Weiterentwicklung unserer Kontenstruktur.

Was du mitbringst

  • Tiefes Buchhaltungsverständnis: Du kannst Abläufe erklären und erkennst, wenn etwas fachlich fehlt oder nicht stimmt. Erfahrung in der Immobilien- oder WEG-Buchhaltung ist besonders wertvoll.

  • Produktdenken: Du hinterfragst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, unterscheidest echte Anforderungen von Gewohnheiten und entwickelst Ideen für bessere Abläufe.

  • Analytische Stärke: Du zerlegst komplexe Probleme, vergleichst Lösungswege und erkennst, welcher nächste Schritt den größten Nutzen bringt.

  • Technische Neugier: Du möchtest verstehen, wie unsere Software funktioniert, und kannst Anforderungen und Abwägungen mit Engineers diskutieren.

  • Klare Kommunikation und Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Fachlichkeit, Nutzerperspektive und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bleibst an einer Lösung, bis sie praktisch funktioniert.

Besonders relevant ist Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung oder Verbesserung von Buchhaltungssoftware. Dein bisheriger Jobtitel ist dabei zweitrangig: Entscheidend ist, dass du Buchhaltung verstehst und daraus sinnvolle Softwarelösungen ableiten kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Recherche, Prototypen oder Tests ist ein Plus.

Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest

  • Dein Fachwissen verändert das Produkt: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die unsere Software nutzen, und siehst, was deine Entscheidungen im Alltag bewirken.

  • Du ergänzt ein starkes Team: Engineering und Design bringen ihre Expertise ein. Gemeinsam könnt ihr Probleme von der fachlichen Ursache bis zur fertigen Lösung bearbeiten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse schaffen Möglichkeiten: Wir wachsen schnell und geben Menschen Verantwortung, die etwas bewegen.

  • Du baust langfristig mit: Unsere Mission ist, Wohneigentum zugänglicher zu machen. Gute Software und funktionierende Hausverwaltungen bilden dafür die Grundlage.

Deine Benefits

  • Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro.

  • Verpflegung: 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget.

  • Sport: 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

  • Weiterentwicklung: 1.200 € Bildungsbudget pro Jahr.

  • Lesestoff: Bücher, die du lesen möchtest, übernehmen wir.

Du verstehst Buchhaltung und hast konkrete Ideen, wie Software sie besser machen kann? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

  • Ability to maintain full ownership and visibility on shared accounts

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière.

Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

3 premiers mois :

- Tu te formes sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

 

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

 

En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

 

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et cherche à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et cabinet à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

 

3 premiers mois :

 

- Tu intègres la Pennylane Academy et tu te formes en continu sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

 

4 à 6 mois :

 

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

 

Et ensuite... :

 

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

 

Compétences requises

 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul.e et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

jobs.description:
DevOps Engineer - SIP Core (Voice Platform)

Help us run and evolve a mission-critical SIP platform used by business customers every day. In this role, you ensure stability and availability while actively driving automation and modernization of our voice services. You’ll work in a DevOps setup with real ownership and impact — from operations to continuous improvement. What you can expect: -High-impact role on a critical VoIP platform (SIP Core / Ribbon) -Modern DevOps environment with automation and continuous improvement -Collaboration across network, architecture, and operations teams -Agile setup (SAFe) with real influence in PI Planning and execution -Room to shape and improve systems — not just operate them.

What impact will you have?

- Operate and improve SIP-based telecommunication backend systems
- Ensure high availability, stability, and performance of voice services
- Monitor systems proactively and prevent incidents
- Troubleshoot complex issues and perform root cause analysis
- Test and deploy updates, fixes, and improvements
- Drive automation, monitoring, and operational efficiency
- Contribute to capacity planning and system health checks
- Maintain and improve documentation and runbooks
- Participate in on-call rotation (Engineer on Duty)


Must-haves:
- Experience operating SIP/VoIP platforms (ideally Ribbon SIP Core)
- Strong knowledge of SIP, VoIP protocols, and secure transport (RTP, SRTP, TLS)
- Solid networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, switching, IPSec)
- Experience with Linux systems and system operations
- Hands-on mindset in troubleshooting and problem-solving
- Good English skills (C1)

Nice-to-haves:

- Automation & DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins, Git, Terraform, Ansible)
- Scripting skills (Python, Bash)
- Experience with Kubernetes / cloud environments
- Familiarity with monitoring tools and ITSM / ITIL
- Experience working in agile setups
- German language skills


Want to know more about us?

We are serving the Swiss market as Switzerland’s leading IT & Telecom company. Thus, we are actively driving digitalization and networking, and tapping new paths for our customers and our employees. Our values are sparking passion, aiming high and standing true.

Since 2019, we have been building up the coolest DevOps Center with a wonderful office at the World Trade Center in the heart of Rotterdam. We are currently recruiting IT passionate professionals who are keen on developing high-quality software, have an agile mindset and appreciate the collaboration with motivated colleagues from all over the world.

What's in it for you?

Work environment

  • Agile way of working, multi-cultural work environment promoting work-life balance

  • Autonomy, flexibility, opportunity and growth

  • Cool office space in the World Trade Center Rotterdam!

  • Are you coming to the office by bike or car? You can park right here at the office

  • Be a part of our events to build a stronger Swisscom community - for example, culture lunches, fun quizzes, game nights and a lot more!

Allowances

  • Full relocation support (Housing, settling in, etc.) for you and your family

  • 200 euros per month Telephone/internet allowance

  • 275 euros per month contribution to health insurance

  • 5 Paid training days and access to Swisscom learning platforms

  • Travel allowance reimbursement

  • 500 euros home office allowance

  • Gym subscription, Tax advice, and language course

  • Salary range: 60,000 to 72,000 euros gross per year including holiday allowance

Leaves policy

  • Care, bereavement, maternity and paternity leaves

  • 25 days paid vacation days plus Dutch national holidays

Contract terms

  • To begin with you will receive a fixed term contract (one year), after 6 months of your employment with us, after a feedback meeting with the team, there is a possibility of extending the contract 

  • The salary ranges mentioned in our Job Descriptions are base annual gross salaries including the 8% holiday allowance

  • Since this role consists of varying seniorities, the salary range is between 60k to 75k euros gross per year, including the 8% holiday allowance

jobs.title: Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Senior Partner Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)

You'll own iwoca's most strategic partnerships in Germany, from the first conversation with a bank, payment provider or business software platform to a live integration that funds small businesses. Your mission is to bring fast, flexible finance to the places where SMEs already run their business.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4.5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Partner Acquisition Germany team builds the partner channel through which iwoca reaches small businesses in Germany: comparison platforms and brokers, banks, payment providers, business software providers and financial advisors who offer iwoca's finance to their customers at the moment it is needed. The team works with three partnership models, from a co-branded referral link and a partner portal to a full API integration, and measures its success by partners that are live and funding customers.

The team is small and works closely together: the Head of Partner Acquisition Germany, a Strategy & Data Manager who owns market analysis, business cases and the CRM, and the partner managers who own the relationships. The team prioritises partners by strategic fit, works through warm introductions and existing networks wherever possible, and stays close to every new partner until the first customers are funded. It works hand in hand with Relationship Management and the product and engineering teams in London / Berlin / Frankfurt that build the integrations.

The role

This is a senior role with full ownership of the partners you pursue. Three things matter more than anything else: You will qualify before you sell, because the best partnerships begin with a genuine customer need. You know how to activate networks and create warm introductions rather than relying solely on cold outreach. And you consider a deal complete only when the partnership is live, working well and funding its first customers. You'll travel across Germany one to two days a week for face-to-face partner meetings, industry events and trade fairs.

Ownership and impact

  • Own a portfolio of the highest-value partnership prospects in Germany, from first conversation to signed contract and live integration.

  • Lead negotiations with founders, managing directors and heads of product or partnerships at banks, payment providers, business software platforms and financial intermediaries.

  • Design the cooperation model and commercial terms for each partner so that the partnership works for both sides over years, not quarters.

  • Bring every partner to go-live with a committed internal promoter and a first concrete use case, so that your work turns into funded customers and long-term value.

Autonomy, backed by a dedicated strategy and data function

  • Spend your time on relationships and deals, with a Strategy & Data Manager who builds target models, business cases and CRM automation alongside you for your prospects and partners.

  • Own your pipeline end to end and keep it transparent, so that forecasts and decisions rest on input and numbers everyone trusts.

  • Decide together with the Head of Partner Acquisition which segments and partners you pursue and where you say no.

Influence on product and strategy

  • Feed what you learn from partners directly into our partnership models, the integration roadmap and the go-to-market plan for Germany.

  • Shape the activation playbook for new partners and the handover to Key Account Management together with the Head of Business Development.

  • Represent iwoca at the industry events, trade fairs and partner roundtables that matter for SME finance in Germany.

The requirements

Essential:

  • At least five years of experience in B2B partnerships, business development or key account management in fintech, banking, payments or business software. You can show a proven track record of closing complex deals with six to twelve month sales cycles at C-Level, founder, board or head-of-department level.

  • A working understanding of how a financing product is integrated into a partner's platform: APIs, embedded finance and how a partner's customer data can be used in the application journey. You won't build integrations yourself (our engineering teams do that), but you need to lead that conversation credibly.

  • Professional fluency in German and English.

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

Bonus:

  • An existing network among German banks, payment providers, brokers or business software platforms.

  • Experience with lending, working capital or other financial products for small businesses.

  • Experience managing a partner pipeline in HubSpot and using data to prioritise targets.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

The salary

We expect to pay from €70,000 - €85,000 base salary plus a performance-related bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • A smart, motivated and international team (we represent over 35 different nationalities) with a ridiculous growth-mindset.

  • 26 days of vacation a year plus a free day for your birthday.

  • One-month fully paid sabbatical after 4 years.

  • Mental health support with direct access to certified psychologists via our partner OpenUp.

  • iwoca takes over a ski chalet in winter so that you and your team can ski or snowboard (and work) for a week. During summer we are drawn to the sun. We’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

  • Access to the gym membership program, €25 for either Fit711 or Urban Sports Club.

  • €30 contribution towards the Deutschlandticket.

  • Company Pension with Canada Life.

  • Great office locations. In Frankfurt in the middle of the city, our Berlin office is located in Prenzlauer Berg.

  • A paid volunteer day that gives you the opportunity to invest time to support a charity of your choice.

  • Corporate Benefits discounts.

  • ’iwocans’ also benefit from fully stocked fridges in our offices with whatever is needed to strengthen them. There are snacks (both healthy and less healthy) for the whole day.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone, including a book budget.

  • Learning German budget.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

jobs.title: Senior GNSS Software Architect / Principal GNSS Engineer
jobs.description:
Join our cutting-edge start-up adventure!

Who are we?

Join the Revolution in GNSS and IoT Connectivity

At Qualinx, we’re not just building chips, we’re engineering the future fabric of the connected world. As a pioneering semiconductor scale-up, we’re transforming how devices connect, communicate, and operate through our ground-breaking Digital RF technology. Our mission goes beyond ultra-low power GNSS: we’re redefining what’s possible in adaptive, scalable, and intelligent connectivity for the Internet of Things.

Born from deep-tech innovation at TU Delft, our team of visionary engineers and bold thinkers is tackling the toughest challenges in GNSS and IoT, starting with power consumption and expanding into dynamic, context-aware solutions that adapt to any environment or use case. We’ve already achieved what many thought impossible: the world’s most advanced GNSS chipset. But that’s just the beginning.

At Qualinx, we believe that the future of connectivity lies in precision, efficiency, and adaptability. Our ambition is to become the invisible thread that seamlessly interconnects billions of devices: powering a smarter, more responsive world.

What Sets Us Apart

Joining Qualinx is about becoming part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. We hold ourselves to high standards, thrive on solving the unexpected, and push boundaries together. But we also know how to enjoy the ride. Our culture is a unique blend of curiosity, team spirit, and a touch of unconventional charm. It’s fast-paced, fun, and grounded in a sober sense of purpose and perspective. Whether we’re deep in design reviews or sharing laughs over lunch, we’re building something meaningful together. At Qualinx, you’re not just contributing to a ground-breaking technology, you’re helping shape a team that’s redefining what it means to work in deep tech.

Job Description 

  • Define and own the end-to-end GNSS receiver software architecture, including acquisition, tracking, measurement engine, navigation, and positioning stack. 

  • Lead architectural decisions for low-power, high-performance GNSS chipsets, balancing performance, power, and silicon constraints. 

  • Translate product requirements into scalable, modular, and maintainable software architectures. 

  • Drive design trade-offs across algorithm complexity, hardware acceleration, and system constraints. 

  • Design and optimize advanced algorithms for: GNSS acquisition and tracking (multi-constellation, multi-frequency), Positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT), Multipath mitigation and interference suppression, Snapshot and ultra-low-power GNSS techniques 

  • Lead development of next-generation techniques such as: Assisted GNSS (A-GNSS), Hybrid positioning (GNSS + Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/IMU), LEO-PNT and emerging navigation paradigms 

  • Oversee implementation of GNSS algorithms in embedded C on RTOS / bare-metal systems, FPGA with focus on performance optimization, high-volume silicon deployment 

  • Mentor and guide engineers, contractors in GNSS algorithms and embedded development. Set technical direction and promote engineering best practices, design standards and lead technical reviews, architecture discussions, decision-making processes. 

  • Cross-Functional collaboration with product management to shape feature roadmap and differentiation strategy. Present technical concepts and results to internal and external stakeholders, including leadership teams and customers. 

Job requirements

Must haves 

Qualinx is looking for a result-driven and conscientious GNSS Engineer. Someone who thrives in an environment where your proactive and can-do attitude is highly appreciated. The ideal candidate for this role must have: 

  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, or related field. 

  • 10+ years of experience in GNSS, wireless communication systems, or signal processing. 

  • Proven track record in GNSS system design and product development. 

  • Deep understanding of the GNSS signal processing chain, including: 

  • Acquisition, tracking, measurements, and navigation 

  • Strong expertise in: 

  • Embedded C/C++ development on RTOS or bare-metal platforms 

  • MATLAB and Python for modelling and algorithm development 

  • Experience with full chip/product lifecycle, from concept to production. 

  • Strong understanding of low-power embedded system design and optimization. 

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and technical leadership skills. 

Nice to have 

  • Experience in GNSS software architecture ownership for commercial products. 

  • Knowledge of multi-constellation and multi-frequency GNSS systems (GPS, Galileo, BeiDou, GLONASS). 

  • Experience with RF front-end integration, calibration, and lab validation setups. 

  • Familiarity with FPGA prototyping and ASIC design flows. 

  • Knowledge of: 

  • SDR (Software Defined Radio) systems 

  • Wireless technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, IoT positioning) 

  • Sensor fusion and hybrid positioning systems 

  • LEO-PNT, GNSS-R, or emerging navigation technologies 

  • High precision positioning 

  • Demonstrated experience in leading teams or mentoring engineers. 


What's in it for you?

At Qualinx, we believe that great work starts with a great environment, pioneering technology and a fun dynamic market to address. Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:

jobs.description:

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is launching a Professional Services organization to accelerate customer success, reduce time-to-value, and drive enterprise adoption for agentic workloads. As a Principal Solution Architect, you'll play a critical role in building and scaling this function. You will join a team of seasoned experts with deep experience backed by Docker's unmatched reach across Fortune 500 companies.

This is a high-visibility role working directly with senior leadership across revenue, product, marketing, and partner organizations. You'll shape service strategy, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver offerings that accelerate both services revenue and platform expansion.

You'll serve as a trusted advisor to our largest and most strategic partners and enterprise customers, providing thought leadership on integrating Docker agentic solutions within enterprise environments.

Responsibilities

Build and Scale the Professional Services Practice

  • Develop and codify repeatable reference architecture patterns across Docker's core use cases including self-hosted and air-gapped deployments, MCP (model context protocol)/AI agent environments, IDP integrations, and secure supply chain workflows so that engagements scale consistently across customers and partners.

  • Translate reference architectures into customer-facing technical collateral, SOW templates, and success patterns that reduce scoping time and improve delivery consistency.

  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and revenue teams to integrate services into GTM motions and align delivery to Docker's AI platform roadmap.

  • Identify offerings that drive product expansion, renewals, and long-term customer value.

  • Support Partnerships & Alliances in selecting, onboarding, and enabling technical integration partners, system integrators (SIs), and service delivery partners.

Drive Strategic Customer Outcomes

  • Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, helping them adopt modern patterns for containerization, AI workflows, and secure software supply chains.

  • Lead technical discovery and architecture engagements that span enterprise integration layers

  • Architect and deliver self-hosted Docker deployments within air-gapped, regulated, and complex enterprise environments including local image registry setup, offline toolchain configuration, and compliance-driven infrastructure design.

  • Design and Guide customers through implementation of agentic AI toolchains, including MCP server/client architecture, tool orchestration, observability integration and secure deployment patterns aligned to Docker's AI platform.

  • Position Docker as a strategic and thought leadership partner, influencing long-term technology adoption and investment decisions.

  • Directly deliver or assign and oversee appropriate delivery partners to execute service engagements and ensure technical objectives are met.

Enable Cross-Functional Success

  • Drive alignment and decision-making across multiple stakeholders and teams without direct reporting lines.

  • Translate field insights including enterprise integration patterns, IDP/SSO friction points, observability gaps, and AI deployment challenges into actionable product and services strategy, roadmap, and partner capabilities.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years as a Professional Services Solution Architect, Technical Consultant, or similar role at a SaaS/infrastructure company or consulting firm.

  • Demonstrated experience architecting and deploying self-hosted and air-gapped deployment architectures: local image registries, offline toolchain configuration, network-isolated Kubernetes clusters, and compliance-driven infrastructure constraints common in regulated industries.

  • Enterprise integration experience across Identity Providers (Okta, Azure AD, LDAP/Active Directory) and federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML, SSO), including RBAC design within complex, multi-tenant enterprise environments.

  • Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its application to agentic AI toolchains including MCP server/client architecture, tool and resource orchestration, and secure containerized deployment patterns.

About the role 🚀

  • Demo Ownership: Design, build and deliver compelling, tailored demonstrations of Qantev's AI-driven claims platform, from first-meeting demos to in-depth deep dives with insurers' business, medical and IT teams.

  • RFP/RFI & Security Reviews: Own the technical sections of RFPs/RFIs, as well as IT, security and compliance questionnaires (architecture, hosting, GDPR and local data regulations).
  • Trusted Advisor: Act as the technical point of contact for clients throughout the sales cycle, build strong relationships with their IT and business leaders, and ensure a smooth handover to the delivery team.
  • Assets & Enablement: Create and maintain reusable assets (demo scripts, architecture diagrams, technical documentation, recorded demos) and train the Sales team to deliver first-level demos.
  • Feedback Loop: Bring client and market feedback to the Product and Engineering teams to inform feature enhancements and roadmap planning.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in a solution architect, solutions engineer, pre-sales , ideally in SaaS, AI/data, insurance or healthcare.
  • Education: Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field. .
  • Languages: Fluent English is required. French, Spanish, Portuguese or an Asian language are a plus.
  • Proven track record of delivering engaging, high-impact demos to both C-level and technical audiences, with strong storytelling skills.
  • Solid technical background: software and cloud architecture (AWS, Azure or GCP), APIs and integration patterns, data pipelines, security; hands-on with SQL and/or Python to prepare demo data.
  • Good understanding of AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI concepts. Knowledge of health insurance or claims processes is a strong plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical topics simple and convincing, both orally and in writing.
  • Client-first mindset: you enjoy being in front of clients, listening to their challenges and shaping tailored solutions.
  • Autonomous and structured, able to manage several opportunities in parallel in a fast-paced scale-up environment.
  • Willingness to travel internationally (Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Latin America) as required.

Opportunity to join a challenging environment among top-notch engineers and experienced entrepreneurs.

Develop a deep understanding of the health insurance industry.

Take part in scaling a global tech start-up.

Navigo reimbursement.

jobs.title: Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Joining Weezevent means working on tangible solutions used at international festivals (Hellfest, Boomtown, Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, Boom), major sporting events (Formula 1, the Olympic Games, Euro fan zones), and high-volume live experiences.

Weezevent builds the technology behind live events: ticketing, cashless payment, CRM, staff solutions and access control. We are about 100 people in the tech team (engineering and product organisation), part of a group that has grown both organically and through acquisitions, so our teams span several countries and cultures.

We are at an inflection point. We are opening a focused 12–18 month window to invest heavily in the foundations of our main product, WeezTicket: paying down technical debt, tightening our architecture, and setting ourselves up for the next phase of growth. To run that program, we’re hiring an Engineering Delivery & Operations Manager (M/F, based in Clichy) to own its delivery.

Vos missions

This is a two-part role, and the first part is where you’ll spend most of your first year.

Part one : deliver the program. A board of our most experienced engineers is defining the architectural direction and producing a large backlog of clean-up and improvement work. That work will be delivered by several external squads brought in for the program. You own the delivery layer between them: getting squads stood up and productive on time, tracking each one’s pace and quality, and keeping the whole program on schedule.

  • Stand up and onboard external squads, around 20 developers across 5 to 6 squads, on time : access, environments, documentation, and a well-scoped first backlog ready before they start
  • Track the delivery pace of each squad against its commitments, and keep a clear program-level view of what’s on track, slipping, or blocked
  • Hold squads to the quality bar set by the architectural board : tests, reviews, and no new debt introduced while removing old debt
  • Manage cross-squad dependencies so work lands in the right order
  • Track program spend against budget and manage the relationships with the partners supplying the squads
  • Report program status to the CTO and the board on a regular cadence

Part two : become the operational backbone of engineering. As the program matures, you’ll take on the people-operations side of the organisation: helping our managers run great 1:1s and reviews, coordinating the performance cycle, keeping an eye on team capacity and wellbeing, and bringing rigour to tooling and budget. This is what makes the role a long-term home rather than a temporary program job.

You’ll work closely with the CTO, the architectural board, our 4 Team Leads, and the external partners supplying the squads. You won’t set the technical strategy or write the code, you’ll make sure the right work gets delivered, on time, at the right quality.

  • Help 4 Team Leads and 6 Squad Leads run consistent 1:1s and grow as managers
  • Coordinate the performance review cycle and make sure follow-up actions actually happen
  • Keep visibility on team capacity, absences, and early signals of overload or burnout
  • Bring structure to tech budget tracking and to the governance of our tools and licences
  • Support hiring and internal mobility alongside our recruitment team

Vos compétences

Must-haves

  • Experience running a multi-squad delivery program end to end: ideally involving external agencies, consultancies, or contract teams
  • A track record of onboarding external teams onto an existing codebase and getting them productive quickly
  • Comfort owning a backlog, a schedule, and a budget across several parallel workstreams at once
  • The ability to track pace and quality per team and raise problems early, with data
  • Genuine tech literacy: you understand what developers do, can navigate a Jira board, and know what technical debt actually means
  • Fluent French and English

What makes you a strong long-term fit

  • Some experience coaching or supporting managers, or running a performance cycle in a tech company
  • A background that touched engineering, delivery, project management, or product before moving toward operations
  • Analytical rigour: you’re comfortable with numbers, dashboards, and cost reports
  • Direct, honest communication and real discretion with sensitive information

Nice to have

  • A third language (German or Dutch is a real plus given our footprint)
  • Experience working across France, the UK, the Netherlands, or Germany, and an understanding of how management styles differ across them

This is not

  • A role that sets architecture or writes code; that’s the board and the squads
  • A pure recruiter or a corporate-HR profile with no delivery or engineering exposure
  • A process-for-process’s-sake job. We want impact, not bureaucracy

The recruitment process

  • HR interview - background and soft skills
  • Interview with CTO - technical discussion

All our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Why it's a good move

You’ll run a high-visibility program with the direct backing of the CTO and the most senior engineers in the company, in an organisation that has decided to genuinely invest in its technical foundations rather than just talk about it. And when the program lands, you’ll have built yourself a permanent, central role at the heart of how our engineering organisation runs.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Executive DACH (Swiss German-speaking) / (German + French-speaking) based in Netherlands.

Help ambitious Swiss businesses expand internationally by removing the complexities of cross-border hiring and workforce management. As an Account Executive, you will own the full B2B sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding. You will advise founders, HR leaders, and other decision-makers on workforce solutions that enable them to hire talent across borders compliantly. Working in a remote-first, international sales team, you will build a strong pipeline, develop strategic relationships, and turn complex business challenges into commercial opportunities. This role is designed for a results-driven sales professional who combines consultative selling with proactive outbound prospecting and confident deal management. You will have the autonomy to manage your territory, exceed ambitious sales targets, and contribute to the growth of a globally connected business.


Accountabilities:

Take ownership of the complete sales process across assigned Swiss accounts, building a strong pipeline and helping companies understand the value of international workforce solutions. Work closely with prospects and internal sales colleagues to identify business needs, navigate complex buying processes, and consistently achieve commercial objectives.

  • Manage the full sales cycle, from initial prospecting and discovery through qualification, negotiation, closing, and successful customer onboarding.

  • Develop and manage relationships with Swiss companies seeking to expand internationally and hire talent across borders.

  • Conduct thorough discovery conversations to understand hiring plans, business priorities, expansion timelines, and potential compliance risks.

  • Engage founders, HR leaders, and other key stakeholders, building internal champions and demonstrating the business value of proposed solutions to Finance, Legal, and executive decision-makers.

  • Apply structured qualification methodologies, such as MEDDICC, to assess opportunities, prioritize qualified prospects, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

  • Generate new business through proactive outbound activities, including cold calling, personalized outreach, and targeted prospecting around relevant business events and funding announcements.

  • Collaborate with Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to identify and pursue high-value opportunities within the assigned territory.

Former Auditor - Senior Customer Success Manager

As a Senior Customer Success Manager (+Audit Background) at DataSnipper, you own the success of a portfolio of accounts - and you bring something additional to the role: direct experience in audit. You understand how audit teams work, what drives their priorities, and how to connect DataSnipper to the workflows that matter most inside a firm.

You are a reliable, independent operator who applies established CS frameworks and uses your audit knowledge to accelerate adoption, build credibility with audit stakeholders, and design enablement that non-audit CSMs cannot replicate. You manage onboarding, QBRs, health monitoring, and renewals with predictability and follow-through and you do it in a language audit professionals trust.

You may still be developing the full breadth of CS scope, but your audit domain credibility opens doors and unlocks conversations that are otherwise harder to access at this level.

 

About DataSnipper

Audit and finance are still massively manual and we are changing that. DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms.

Now, we are taking things further with our Excel Agent, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens. Unlike generic AI tools, we do not sit on the sidelines. Our AI operates inside Excel, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning it does not just generate answers, it does the work, with full traceability.

We are not just applying AI, we are redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, this is the place.

 

What You Will Do

  • Act as a Credible Audit Advisor: Serve as a trusted partner to Audit Managers, Senior Auditors, and engagement team leads. You are someone who understands customer workflows, their quality standards, and their firm's operating model. Translate DataSnipper's capabilities into language and use cases that resonate with audit professionals directly.

  • Drive Adoption Aligned to Audit Workflows: Run onboarding and training sessions that are grounded in how audit teams actually work - mapping DataSnipper features to real engagement tasks, sample testing approaches, and evidence management requirements.

Align milestones to audit calendar realities and firm methodology, not just generic product adoption targets.

Run QBRs and stakeholder conversations with the credibility of someone who has worked in the field.

  • Support Expansion Using Domain Knowledge: Identify expansion signals within your portfolio and use your understanding of firm structure such as service lines, team hierarchies, engagement types to surface credible growth opportunities.   • Maintain Systems and Portfolio Data: Keep customer data, health signals, and portfolio records accurate and up to date in internal systems. Use this data to make better decisions and support reliable reporting.

You understand how audit engagements are structured, what drives adoption in audit teams, and how to speak credibly to audit professionals.

jobs.title: Process Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Functieprofiel

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.


Wat ga jij doen!

In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

  • Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

  • Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

  • Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

  • Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

  • Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

  • Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

  • Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

  • Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

Wat wij vragen!

  • Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

  • Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering

  • Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC

  • Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT

  • Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI

  • De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen


Wat bieden wij jou!

Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd.

Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities.

Daarnaast:

  • In 2024 is een nieuwe fabriek gerealiseerd

  • Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT

  • Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses

  • Mogelijkheden voor remote support

jobs.title: Data Engineer - AI Pipelines & DataOps
jobs.description:
We Want You to Grow With Us

High-quality, reliable data is the foundation on which every AI use case is built, and this role is responsible for making that foundation unshakeable. As our Data Engineer for AI Pipelines & DataOps, you will design and deliver the ingestion pipelines, streaming architectures, and APIs that feed Intersnack's AI and analytics systems with the data they need to perform at scale. You will report into the AI Programme and work in close collaboration with AI engineers, data architects, and business teams, with a particular focus on manufacturing environments, where edge device data presents unique ingestion challenges. At Intersnack, we build on a solid digital foundation, and your engineering work will be central to extending that foundation into the AI era.

What We Can Offer

This role offers the opportunity to work across a genuinely diverse data landscape, from manufacturing edge devices and IoT sensors to structured enterprise data systems across procurement and sales, giving you breadth of technical challenge that few data engineering roles can match. You will have direct influence over how AI and analytics use cases are enabled across a 4.5bn euro business, with the autonomy to define pipeline patterns, API standards, and DataOps practices that others will build on. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and you will be embedded in a programme team that spans data science, AI architecture, and business enablement. Dusseldorf is the home base, with flexibility for remote working.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Data Engineer - AI Pipelines & DataOps

You will design and build the data infrastructure that powers Intersnack's AI programme, from scalable ingestion pipelines that handle both structured enterprise data and unstructured signals from manufacturing environments, to the APIs that expose data, models, and AI services for consumption across the organisation. Your work will span architecture, implementation, and operations, with a strong focus on quality, observability, and continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

  • Design and implement scalable data ingestion pipelines for structured and unstructured data sources, including manufacturing systems, edge devices, and enterprise data platforms, ensuring consistent data quality from source to consumption

  • Build and maintain both batch and streaming data pipelines for analytics and AI use cases, leveraging cloud-native tooling on Microsoft Azure and/or AWS

  • Design and expose REST or GraphQL APIs for data assets, machine learning model endpoints, and AI services, enabling reliable, governed consumption by internal applications and analytical systems

  • Implement CI/CD practices and DataOps principles across pipeline development and deployment, supporting automated testing, versioning, and release management for data infrastructure

  • Ensure data quality, lineage, and observability across all pipelines, implementing monitoring and alerting that surfaces data issues before they affect AI or analytics outputs

  • Support the integration of manufacturing and edge device data, including IoT and OT systems, into the central data platform, addressing the specific latency, format, and volume challenges of operational technology environments

  • Collaborate with data scientists and AI engineers to design and optimise data flows that support model training, inference, and knowledge retrieval pipelines

  • Apply security-by-design practices to all pipeline and API design, including access control, encryption, and protections against data leakage, in line with Intersnack's sovereignty and compliance standards

  • Contribute to the AI literacy and enablement programme by supporting colleagues in understanding data pipeline health, data quality standards, and the role of reliable data in AI outcomes


Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Proven experience designing and implementing production-grade data pipelines using cloud-native services on Microsoft Azure (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure Event Hubs, Databricks) and/or AWS (e.g., AWS Glue, Kinesis, Lake Formation)

  • Strong proficiency in at least one pipeline or transformation framework (e.g., Apache Spark, dbt, Apache Kafka, or equivalent) and a scripting language such as Python or Scala

  • Solid hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB, or equivalent), including data modelling and query optimisation for both transactional and analytical workloads

  • Experience building and maintaining streaming and batch pipelines for analytics and AI applications, with an understanding of trade-offs between the two approaches

  • Ability to design and implement REST or GraphQL APIs for data and model serving, with an understanding of API versioning, documentation, and governance

  • Familiarity with DataOps and CI/CD practices as applied to data engineering, including automated testing, pipeline orchestration, and infrastructure-as-code

  • Experience with data quality tooling, lineage tracking, and observability frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, OpenLineage, or equivalent)

  • Working knowledge of AI and data security fundamentals, including data access controls, encryption, and risks such as data exfiltration in pipeline contexts

  • Awareness of GDPR, EU AI Act, and EU data sovereignty requirements and their implications for data infrastructure design

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required; knowledge of German is considered an advantage

Valuable Experience

  • Experience working with manufacturing or operational technology (OT) data environments, including IoT/edge device data ingestion and time-series data handling

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, or Azure Purview for unified data platform management

  • Exposure to MLOps practices, including data versioning, feature stores, or model monitoring pipelines

  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tooling for scalable, repeatable data infrastructure deployment

  • Background in FMCG, manufacturing, or supply chain, providing context for the operational data challenges typical in these environments

 

Important: Please note that a valid work and residence permit is required for non-EU applicants for this position.

About Intersnack IT
Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. It’s our target to provide the common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG

About Intersnack Group
Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. For further company insights, please visit the following link: Intersnack Group Overview

If you want to become part of our dynamic food industry success story, you’ll find all sorts of opportunities at Intersnack.

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer l’architecture de nos applications, services et produits numériques en cohérence avec les besoins métiers et la trajectoire du SI.

  • Faire évoluer l’existant en identifiant les possibilités de simplification, de modernisation et de restructuration, avec une approche pragmatique de la dette technique.

  • Travailler sur les enjeux transverses du SI avec les équipes infrastructure, sécurité et qualité : cloud, conteneurisation, observabilité, sécurité et évolutions technologiques, notamment autour de l’IA.

  • Vous avez une solide expérience en développement logiciel et avez progressivement élargi votre champ d'intervention vers des problématiques de conception et d’architecture.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Experience developing automated tests using tools such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
