jobs.title: Mid-market Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
UpSlide is the document production layer for financial services.  We orchestrate LLMs, machine learning, and workflow agents within Microsoft 365 to deliver reliable, quality outputs in the most efficient and cost-effective way.

As a Microsoft Solutions Partner, with 14+ years supporting financial services teams, we bring together expertise from the tech, finance and design fields to help clients like KPMG, BNP Paribas, Rothschild & Co. boost productivity while improving brand consistency across their corporate documents. 

We are a certified B Corporation, upholding the belief that businesses should have a positive impact on society.

✨ Our values

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value:

  • Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables.

  • Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

  • Happiness at work: We enjoy looking on the bright side and we share our enthusiasm with our colleagues and clients.

🤝 The team

You will join our Global MidMarket Customer Success team, a group of Customer Success Managers who each own a broad, evolving portfolio of mid-market accounts. While the function operates globally, this specific opening is dedicated to the EMEA & APAC regions

Based in Paris, you will work closely with 2 Mid-Market CSMs (1 in London, 1 in NYC) and 1 Scale Ops Manager (Paris). Matthieu, Head of Scale CSM and your manager, based in Paris, will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our international offices.

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide:

  • Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts

  • Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment

  • Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth. Split between Enterprise CSMs, who build deep, tailored relationships with a small number of strategic accounts, and Mid-Market CSMs, who manage a larger book of accounts with a focus on speed and ROI, acting where and when it counts

  • Support Engineers: Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience

🖋️ Your responsibilities

As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager, you will own a broad portfolio of Mid-Market accounts end-to-end. Working at pace and using usage data and account signals to prioritize your day, you will make sure your accounts renew, stay healthy, and grow, spotting upsell/expand opportunities as proactively as you spot churn risk, and owning both through to close.

This is a role for someone energized by volume and by building repeatable, data-driven ways of working across a large book of business, without losing the client-first mindset that drives portfolio growth.

Portfolio Ownership & Signal-Driven Execution (60%)

Own the business performance and KPIs of a large portfolio of Mid-Market accounts, and take individual accountability for contributing to team and company targets:

  • Own your portfolio's KPIs (usage, renewal rate, NRR, churn) end to end with a hunter/rescuer mindset: moving fast to capture opportunity, and stepping in decisively when an account is at risk

  • Structure your coverage around two core touchpoints, kickoff and renewal, complemented by additional touchpoints where and when the data calls for it

  • Continuously monitor usage data, health scores, and other signals to prioritize your day and catch risk or opportunity early

  • React quickly and decisively on negative signals to protect the account, and on positive signals to capture upsell potential

  • Judge, account by account, how much time and effort a situation deserves, and adjust your touchpoint cadence accordingly - guided increasingly by shared scoring and playbooks as the Scale motion matures

Product & Industry Expertise (20%)

Build broad product and industry expertise to support adoption at scale, rather than deep knowledge of any single client:

  • Develop a strong understanding of UpSlide's product and of the industries your portfolio operates in

  • Contribute to adoption initiatives such as webinars and open office hours, sharing your expertise across the client base

Scale Motion Optimization (10%)

Bring a critical eye to how the Mid-Market motion runs, and help make it faster and more effective:

  • Share structured feedback on where automation and process changes can save time

  • Suggest and help build content that increases client engagement and adoption

  • Work closely with the Scale Ops Manager and the Head of Scale to turn feedback into concrete improvements

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%)

Stay connected to the teams around your portfolio, notably those handling first-line requests:

  • Sync regularly with Support and Sales Admin, who own level 1 requests and escalate to you when needed

  • Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities that require broader support

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, Notion (or local equivalents).

⚡ Your goals

What you'll be assessed on:

  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

  • Churn

  • Upsell / Expansion contribution

  • CRM data quality and forecast accuracy


You are a great fit if you have:

  • 2/3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role in a B2B environment

  • Proven experience managing renewals and churn across a portfolio of accounts, with the confidence to handle difficult conversations (renegotiation, dissatisfaction) as needed

  • Proven ability to identify and close expansion/upsell opportunities, with a hunter mindset and a strong ROI orientation

  • Experience autonomously managing a sizeable portfolio, ideally including Mid-Market accounts

  • A structured, analytical approach to account planning at volume, using data to prioritize a broad book of business and anticipate risk

  • Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in French and English

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment

We’d love it if you have:

  • Experience with analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent)

  • Advanced negotiation skills

  • Knowledge of the financial services / professional services sector

  • Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.

Recruitment process

  1. Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role.

  2. Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management.

  3. Case study + team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team.

  4. Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps.

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH, which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year)

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc.

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities

👶 Family support:

  • Paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 4 days fully paid leave for sick children up to 6 years old or up to €1,800 for childcare reimbursement

  • Flexible return to work options

  • An additional 5 days are fully paid within 6 months after becoming a parent

✈️ Holidays: 25 vacation days and 9 RTT (with one taken for Solidarity Day)

✅ General:

  • Meal vouchers (Tickets resto): €11 per day on your Swile card (210 tickets per year)

  • Healthcare insurance (Mutuelle): Covered by Alan. You can extend cover to your partner and children

  • Commute (Transports): Metro, RER, bike, or e-scooter - These options are reimbursed 50% by UpSlide

As a B Corp-certified company, we have strong commitments toward our employees, community, clients, suppliers, and the environment. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels welcome. This commitment to diversity and inclusion is applied in our recruitment process and your employee experience once you’ve joined UpSlide ✨

jobs.description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe

 

The mission

At Lucis, we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here.

 

The role

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead. You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own

Day One: Hands-On Frontline Support

  • Frontline Excellence: Personally resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat and phone, delivering high-touch support from day one.

  • Internal Product Mastery: Act as our expert power user, testing our internal OS and advocating for tool improvements that boost operational efficiency.

  • NPS & Proactive Care: Design proactive care initiatives to ensure member satisfaction remains consistently best-in-class.

Post-Ramp: Team Scale & Process

  • Team Scaling & Playbooks: Build, mentor, and lead a growing support team while writing our core SOPs, escalation pathways, and training guides.

  • Cross-Functional Feedback: Turn daily support interactions into structured insights that directly inform product roadmap decisions.

 

About you

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

 

You’ll fit in well if

  • Experience: 2+ years in high-volume B2C customer care or support, with a track record of mentoring peers and a readiness to step into your first formal lead role.

  • Bilingual Skills: Fluent in both English and French (written and spoken).

  • People-First Energy: You bring genuine warmth, high empathy, and enthusiasm to every interaction, turning routine support into remarkable member experiences.

  • Phone-First Instinct: You default to picking up the phone whenever a complex issue calls for a personal touch.

  • Rigorous Precision: Exceptional attention to detail with zero tolerance for misquotes, incorrect details, or operational errors.

Nice to have

  • Regulated Industry Experience: Prior background in healthtech, fintech, or another high-compliance consumer space where accuracy is critical.

The process

  • Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

  • Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

  • Reference calls

How we work

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

  • Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

  • Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

  • Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen?

Samen met de CEO en COO werk je aan de verdere strategische en financiële ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Als CFO vertaal je de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete groeikansen door schaalbare verdien- en prijsmodellen te ontwikkelen. Per markt, regio, entiteit, businessunit en klantsegment analyseer je waar kansen liggen, op basis van verwachte klantwaarde, omzetpotentieel, kosten, marge, cashflow, risico en schaalbaarheid. Deze inzichten verwerk je in businesscases waarin zowel het perspectief van de klant als van Voortman Steel Machinery naar voren komen.

 

Daarnaast ontwikkel je heldere investeringskaders en breng je passende financieringsmodellen in kaart die aansluiten op de aard van de activiteiten en de internationale context. Daarbij weeg je beschikbare financieringsopties zorgvuldig af op impact, liquiditeit en rendement. Op basis daarvan adviseer je de board over prioriteiten en zorg je dat middelen terechtkomen bij de initiatieven die het meest bijdragen aan de strategische en financiële doelstellingen van Voortman Steel Machinery. Als onderdeel hiervan bepaal je ook onder welke financiële en organisatorische voorwaarden pilots kunnen worden gestart en opgeschaald. Met heldere go/no-go-momenten per fase zorg je ervoor dat de ontwikkeling en implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen niet sneller gaat dan wat de organisatie kan adopteren. Daarnaast monitor je de financiële resultaten van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen en bepaal je of de uitrol moet worden versneld, voortgezet, bijgestuurd of afgeschaald. Tegelijkertijd borg je dat contracten allesomvattende afspraken en een evenwichtige risicoverdeling bevatten, evenals uitvoerbaar zijn in alle landen waar Voortman Steel Machinery actief is. Zo werk je gericht aan verdien- en prijsmodellen die commercieel aantrekkelijk, financieel gezond en schaalbaar zijn.

 

Als CFO draag je actief bij aan de verdere internationale groei van Voortman Steel Machinery. Hiervoor ontwikkel je strategische, financiële en organisatorische plannen, zodat per markt en internationale entiteit helder is welke inrichting het beste past bij de gewenste groei. Daarbij verzorg je de afstemming tussen verschillende afdelingen en entiteiten, zonder de lijnverantwoordelijkheid van collega's over te nemen. Tevens bewaak je per land en internationale entiteit het rendement, de cashflow, het werkkapitaal en houd je zicht op financiële, juridische, fiscale, contractuele en compliance-risico’s.

Ook de financiële besturing en beheersing van Voortman Steel Machinery valt onder jouw verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent internationaal eindverantwoordelijk voor consolidatie, planning & control, reporting, accounting, treasury, audit, tax, vennootschapsbelasting en interne beheersing. Aansluitend zie je toe op het opstellen van correcte en transparante rapportages per internationale entiteit. De dagelijkse coördinatie van deze verschillende activiteiten en de aansturing van de Finance-afdeling wordt verzorgd door de Finance-director, waarmee je nauw samenwerkt. Jij fungeert als sparringpartner, stuurt bij waar nodig, bewaakt de strategisch richting van de Finance-afdeling, verzorgt correcte governance en behandeld onderwerpen met board impact. Tevens ben je het gezicht van Voortman Steel Machinery richting banken, verzekeraars, accountant en andere financiële stakeholders.

 

Wat maakt deze rol uniek?

In deze rol krijg je de kans om zichtbaar richting te geven aan de volgende groeifase van Voortman Steel Machinery. Je komt terecht in een organisatie waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en slagkracht samenkomen: ideeën worden niet alleen verkend, maar ook scherp getoetst op waardecreatie, rendement, risico en schaalbaarheid. Daarmee krijg je ruimte om jouw financiële expertise en strategisch vermogen in te zetten bij het ontwikkelen van nieuwe proposities, het onderbouwen van businesscases en het bepalen van investeringskeuzes die impact hebben op de internationale groei van de organisatie. Dit maakt de functie nadrukkelijk méér dan een traditionele CFO-rol: je bewaakt niet alleen de financiële basis, maar bent medebepalend in hoe Voortman Steel Machinery commerciële kansen vertaalt naar gezonde, schaalbare en toekomstbestendige groei.

 

Positie binnen de organisatie

Voortman Steel Machinery ontwikkelt machines, software en serviceoplossingen waarmee staalverwerkende bedrijven hun productieprocessen automatiseren en optimaliseren. Het hoofdkantoor is gevestigd in Nederland. Dankzij vestigingen in verschillende landen kan effectieve lokale ondersteuning worden geboden. De recent geopende, grootschalige productielocatie in de Verenigde Staten laat zien hoe de organisatie internationaal blijft groeien. Tevens vindt in Engeland hoofdzakelijk de ontwikkeling van onze LogicSteel-software plaats. Daarnaast bezit Voortman wereldwijd diverse sales & service-hubs.

 

Als CFO vorm je samen met de CEO en COO de board van Voortman Steel Machinery, geef je met hen richting aan de ontwikkeling van het Global Management Team en de organisatie als geheel. Jouw focus ligt op het vertalen van de ondernemingsstrategie naar concrete kansen voor nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen. Hierbij werk je intensief samen met de afdeling Product Management, dat verantwoordelijk is voor het identificeren en ontwikkelen van software-, machine- en serviceproposities. Als CFO ben je eindverantwoordelijk voor de Finance-afdeling en werk je nauw samen met de Finance Director, die de dagelijkse internationale operationele aansturing van de afdeling verzorgt. Tevens rapporteren de HR-Manager en Trade Compliance Officer aan jou. De HR-Manager is (mede) verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van de HR-strategie en het borgen van de operationele uitvoering. Daarnaast ziet de Trade Compliance Officer erop toe dat de organisatie voldoet aan de relevante wet- en regelgeving. Daarbij bewaakt de Trade Compliance Officer onder andere de inhoudelijke juistheid en werking van ingezette maatregelen.


Wat wij bieden?

Bij Voortman Steel Machinery kom je terecht in een écht familiebedrijf met een informele, betrokken en ondernemende cultuur. Mensen kennen elkaar en lijnen zijn kort. Er is volop ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, initiatief te tonen en ideeën verder te brengen. Onze kernwaarden ondernemerschap, vakmanschap, passie voor technologie, toewijding en samenwerking vormen daarbij de basis voor hoe we werken en met elkaar omgaan. Je ziet ze terug in de trots waarmee we hoogwaardige technologie ontwikkelen, in de manier waarop teams elkaar versterken en in de gezamenlijke drive om klanten vooruit te helpen. Zo ontstaat een werkomgeving waarin ambitie, betrokkenheid en werkplezier op een natuurlijke manier samenkomen.

 

Naast een professionele, ondernemende en loyale werkomgeving krijg je bij ons:

  • Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Een passende pensioenregeling bij ASR, waarbij jij en Voortman samen pensioenkapitaal opbouwen;

  • Een leaseauto voor zakelijk en privégebruik;

  • Een sleutelrol in het realiseren van onze strategie met internationale impact;

  • Werken in een moderne omgeving op onze Voortman Campus in Rijssen;

 

Wat breng je mee?

Wij zoeken een ondernemende, strategische en daadkrachtige CFO met een afgeronde masteropleiding in Finance, Economie, Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting. Een titel als RA, RC of CPA is een must. Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als CFO, Divisie-CFO, Senior Finance Director, Head of Finance of Director Corporate Finance, bij voorkeur binnen een internationale original equipment manufacturer (OEM), industrieel technologiebedrijf, technisch complexe B2B-organisatie of top-tier consultancybureau. Ervaring binnen een ondernemend familiebedrijf of een organisatie van vergelijkbare omvang en complexiteit is daarbij een pré. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met aansturen van een finance-afdeling of -team. Verder voldoe je aan het volgende profiel:

 

  • Strategisch en analytisch vermogen: je beschikt over sterk analytisch en strategisch vermogen en hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het doorgronden van complexe data en businessmodellen. Je weet informatie te vertalen naar heldere strategische en financiële logica, logische transparante aannames en goed onderbouwde besluitvorming. Je bent in staat om richting te bepalen, langetermijndoelen te formuleren en de organisatie daarin mee te nemen.

 

  • Businessmodelinnovatie: je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het in kaart brengen van groeikansen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe (schaalbare) verdien-, prijs- en contractmodellen. Deze weet je te onderbouwen met solide businesscases en scenarioanalyses. Daarnaast heb je ruime ervaring met het ontwikkelen van financieringsmodellen en het inrichten van kapitaalallocatie op basis van het (verwachte) rendement, risico’s en strategische bijdrage.

 

  • Besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht: je bent besluitvaardig en kunt tijdig en doordacht keuzes maken op basis van beschikbare informatie. Als je éénmaal een keuze hebt gemaakt, durf je achter je keuze te blijven staan. Je beschikt over overtuigingskracht, kunt draagvlak creëren en interne en externe stakeholders zorgvuldig meenemen in strategische veranderingen. Tevens stuur je actief op concrete resultaten en realiseer je aantoonbare positieve financiële impact.

 

  • Verandervermogen en omgevingsbewustzijn: je hebt ervaring met het realiseren van interne veranderingen en de implementatie van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen, evenals het tijdig bijsturen daarvan. Tevens ben je sterk in het vertalen van nieuwe verdien- en prijsmodellen naar heldere, beheersbare processen en rollen. Daarbij zorg je voor een gestructureerde stapsgewijze implementatie en ben je sterk in het meenemen en begeleiden van collega’s tijdens veranderingen. Ook onder druk en in complexe situaties blijf je rustig, behoud je overzicht en kun je snel schakelen. Tevens heb je een scherp oog voor verhoudingen, kun je belangen goed afwegen en anticipeer je tijdig op ontwikkelingen. Daarbij heb je een goed begrip van culturele en organisatorische verschillen in een internationale context.

 

  • Verbindend vermogen en communicatie: je bent betrokken en weet duurzame professionele relaties op te bouwen en te onderhouden met interne en externe stakeholders, zoals banken, accountants en verzekeraars. Je communiceert helder, informeert betrokkenen tijdig over relevante ontwikkelingen en bent benaderbaar. Je weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk over te brengen en stemt je communicatie af op verschillende gesprekspartners. Daarnaast beschik je over sterke Nederlandse en Engelse communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

 

  • Inspirerend leiderschap: jouw leiderschap is gericht op groei, vertrouwen en ontwikkeling. jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Brand & Experience team builds the emotional connection between Deliveroo and our customers, riders, and partners. With a deep understanding of our audience and a passion for creativity, we bring our brand to life across every touchpoint. Whether it's a push notification, social campaign, or packaging design—we craft compelling experiences that shape perceptions, spark engagement, and make Deliveroo a loved, global brand.

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Integrated Marketing to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you'll help us take ideas from global strategy through to local activation across markets, delivering integrated campaigns that drive measurable business growth.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining the Integrated Marketing team. We own the Deliveroo brand globally and lead our biggest campaign moments. Working in a cross-functional squad alongside strategic teams, functional leads, and local markets, we turn big ideas into high-impact campaigns across our markets.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Global Campaign Ownership: Lead high-profile global marketing programmes and integrated campaigns from global strategy through to local market execution.

  • Framework & Playbook Development: Design, scale, and maintain measurement frameworks, playbooks, and systems that enable global and local teams to execute best-in-class brand campaigns.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with cross-functional squads, strategic teams, functional leads, and local market leads to align campaign strategies with core business goals.

  • Stakeholder Management: Influence senior stakeholders across the global organisation without direct authority, ensuring alignment on messaging, execution, and performance metrics.

  • Strategic Optimisation: Balance tactical execution with a longer-term strategic perspective to solve complex marketing briefs and continuously optimize brand performance.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Essential

  • Integrated Brand Leadership: Proven experience leading end-to-end global integrated marketing campaigns from initial strategy through to local market activation.

  • Framework Development: Strong track record in establishing measurement frameworks, campaign playbooks, and operational systems that scale across multiple regions.

  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to influence and align senior cross-functional stakeholders and matrix teams without direct line management authority.

  • Strategic & Tactical Execution: Proven ability to operate independently on complex or ambiguous briefs, balancing day-to-day execution with longer-term brand strategy.

  • Commercial Acumen: Strong expertise in linking brand initiatives and marketing campaigns directly to measurable business growth and commercial impact.

Nice to Have

  • Experience navigating three-sided marketplace dynamics or fast-paced consumer tech environments.

  • Background working across international or multi-market structures.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

jobs.title: Talent Community: Account Management Talent
Stage - Data Engineer - ML (H/F)
jobs.description:
Chez Withings, nous développons des appareils de santé connectée : nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs. Notre objectif est de permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de sa santé.

Au sein de l'équipe Machine Learning, nous développons des algorithmes pour extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales pour nos utilisateurs tels que le SPO2, la fréquence cardiaque, la présence de diverses pathologies comme la fibrillation atriale, l'apnée du sommeil…
Nous recherchons un ou une stagiaire motivé.e par des sujets de santé avec des compétences en traitement du signal, en machine learning et en deep learning pour nous aider à concevoir les algorithmes de demain.

Votre mission
L'objectif de ce stage est de concevoir, développer et valider des algorithmes capables d'extraire des informations physiologiques et médicales fiables à partir des signaux physiques collectés par nos dispositifs.
Pour mener à bien cette mission passionnante, la/le stagiaire aura l'opportunité de :

  • Explorer et analyser des ensembles de données physiologiques réelles issues de nos utilisateurs, à la recherche de marqueurs pertinents.
  • Concevoir et développer des algorithmes combinant des techniques de traitement du signal innovantes, des heuristiques informatiques fines, des approches Machine Learning et Deep Learning (supervisé ou non).
  • Travailler sur l'optimisation algorithmique en vue d'une implémentation embarquée, potentiellement en langage C, sur des systèmes aux ressources contraintes.
  • Participer à la définition des critères de succès et des métriques pour le mesurer, et évaluer la performance des algorithmes sur des jeux de données variés.

Ce stage offre une immersion complète dans le développement d'un produit de santé connecté de pointe, avec une application concrète et un impact direct sur la vie des utilisateurs. Vous rejoindrez une équipe multidisciplinaire et dynamique, où votre contribution sera essentielle pour transformer un prototype algorithmique en une fonctionnalité embarquée de nos dispositifs, conforme aux exigences de fiabilité et de performance de l'industrie médicale.
Le sujet précis sera discuté avec le stagiaire au plus tard quelques semaines avant le stage.

Requirements

  • Connaissances théoriques en traitement du signal et en machine learning
  • Compétences informatiques : programmation en Python, première expérience en framework deep learning (PyTorch ou TensorFlow) appréciée
  • Bonus : programmation en C
  • Intérêt pour le machine learning
  • Intérêt pour les applications en santé connectée
  • Lecture de l'anglais scientifique et technique
  • Capacité rédactionnelle, de rigueur et d'autonomie
  • Aptitude pour le travail en équipe et communication
  • Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Assister à des conférences de professionnels de santé afin de renforcer ses connaissances dans le domaine médical
  • Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Chez Agicap, la Data Platform répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform (notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte, dbt et Looker pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables.
🔥 Le chantier qui change tout : l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics. On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique. Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu.


👥L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data). Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations.

L'équipe en 3 mots : soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture.


💪 Tes missions

Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants :

  • Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel.
  • Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery.
  • Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run).
  • Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses.
  • Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA.

👀 Comment on travaille
  • Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite.
  • Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue.
  • Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance.
  • Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains.
  • L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence.
  • Contribution open source : on publie des connecteurs Airbyte.

    • ⭐ Notre stack
    • GCP : BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Composer, GKE, Looker
    • Ingestion : Airbyte self-hosted (CDC PostgreSQL et SQL Server), GCS Avro → tables externes BigQuery
    • Transformation & qualité : dbt, Elementary
    • IaC & CI/CD : Terraform, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions
    • Langages : Python, SQL, Docker
    • IA : Claude Code (skills et plugins internes), serveur MCP interne

    🎯 Le profil qu'on cherche

    Indispensable

    • 5 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Engineering sur un Cloud Provider majeur, avec la responsabilité de maintenir des systèmes en production.
    • SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût).
    • Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts.
    • Python de qualité, testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique.
    • Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien.
    • Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit.
    • Tu es force de proposition, rigoureux·se, humble, et tu aimes transmettre : partager tes découvertes, expliquer tes choix aux équipes techniques comme métier, faire progresser tes collègues.
    • Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote.
    • Anglais B2 minimum.

      • Un gros plus

      • Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership.
      • Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries).

        • Un plus

        • Expérience GCP : BigQuery et son modèle de compute via réservations de slots, Composer, Cloud Run, GKE / Helm.
        • Tu as construit des tools pour agents IA (serveur MCP, skills).
        • Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom).
        • Pipelines data en Change Data Capture.
        • Contribution à l'écosystème Airbyte.

    🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un rôle au cœur d'une AI-first scale-up fintech FT120, €145M levés, 8 000+ clients, 6 pays.
    • Une Data Platform avec un vrai scope stratégique (reporting, IA, data gouvernance) et des sujets de fond pour les 2 prochaines année.
    • Rémunération : 60K€ - 70K€ selon expertise + prime vacances SYNTEC.
    • CDI, forfait 39h dont 4h supplémentaires payées.
    • Full remote  — venues à Lyon ponctuelles pour les moments d'équipe.
    • 25 jours de congés payés + 10 jours de congés flexibles (utilisables dès l'arrivée).
    • Mutuelle Alan (extension famille possible), titres restaurant Swile (11€/jour dont 6,50€ pris en charge).
    • Avantages CSE : carte KDO annuelle, Gymlib / EGYM wellpass, et plus.

    ⏳ Process de recrutement
    1. Screening avec notre Senior Talent Acquisition — 45 min sur ton parcours et ta motivation.
    2. 1er entretien technique avec Pauline (Head of Data) — discussion technique, challenge sur la manière d'aborder des problèmes, cadrage de sujets, use case Agicap — 1h.
    3. 2ème entretien technique avec Kévin (Team Lead DE) et Julien — test SQL + test d'architecture oral + discussion technique + cas IA — 2h.
    Feedback rapide à chaque étape. Process transparent, pas de piège.
    AGICAP s'engage à offrir des opportunités égales à tous, nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif qui valorise la diversité!

jobs.title: Senior Technical Partnerships Manager, MENA (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.


Distribusion is quickly expanding globally and looking for a Senior Technical Partnerships Manager (all genders) to join the Carrier Operations team to drive performance improvements of key carrier partnerships.

What you will do:

  • Provide technical consultation to new partners during product implementation to ensure certification standards are met, and take responsibility for the support and growth of a portfolio of leading transport operators.

  • Define and execute growth initiatives of both commercial and technical nature, coordinating with external and internal stakeholders across integrations, product, business development, and finance teams.

  • Conceptualize and implement operational processes and tooling targeting automation.

  • Build relationships to enhance engagement with our product, guiding development for our core offerings and increasing stickiness to our brand.

Workplace:

We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin.

We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment (e.g. Consulting/Product/Partnership teams in start-ups).

  • Languages: You speak a relevant language to the geography of the role - Arabic at Fluent level

  • You have a working knowledge of APIs and integration technologies, or a strong technical acumen and the ability to grasp new technologies quickly.

  • You naturally build strong commercial and technical relationships with key partners and stakeholders.

  • You possess strong data analytics skills, enabling you to derive valuable insights to drive business decisions.

  • You are effective in cross-functional project management, collaborating closely with both product and engineering teams.

  • You have a strong attention to detail, and you often find bugs or mistakes in products and proactively fix them.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry

  • You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company

  • We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions

  • You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Associate
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What we're looking for

We're looking for someone hungry to learn and early in their career to join us as our Revenue Operations Associate!

You'll get an inside look at, and be a key part of, how a high-performing GTM function operates: this is a great opportunity for exceptionally smart, motivated individuals who want to immerse themselves in the world of tech startups and gain real exposure to what it takes to keep a high-growth business moving.

You'll sit at the intersection of our GTM, Customer and Finance teams, keeping our systems, data, and reporting sharp as we scale. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role – you'll inherit processes that are still being built, and you'll have real room to audit what's working, fix what isn't, and put your own stamp on how we operate.

You'll get broad exposure early: one week you might be untangling a HubSpot workflow, the next you're building a dashboard the CCO takes into a board meeting. It's a genuinely excellent grounding in how a B2B SaaS business scales – but it comes with real pace, longer hours than a typical first job, and a learning curve to match. If you want breadth of exposure and a steep climb early in your career, this is a great seat.

What Can You Expect?

  • Keep our GTM tech stack in good shape: Own day-to-day CRM administration – data hygiene, permissions, and workflow upkeep – and support the configuration and integration of the wider stack.

  • Stay ahead of what's new: Keep across releases and new features across our tools – joining release webinars, reading release notes, and flagging what's worth adopting.

  • Help evaluate and set up new tools: Get involved as we add to the stack, from evaluation through to implementation.

  • Improve our data quality: Spot where data is incomplete or inconsistent, fix what you can, and propose fixes for the rest.

  • Build reporting and dashboards: Turn raw data into dashboards and reports that track pipeline health, funnel conversion, and the other KPIs the GTM team relies on day to day.

  • Support incentive tracking: Help maintain and monitor commission and incentive tracking, making sure calculations are accurate.

  • Onboard new GTM joiners: Train new starters across the GTM and Customer teams on our tools and processes so they're productive quickly.

  • Own our recurring admin cadence: Take ownership of the regular tasks that keep the engine running and look to automate where ever possible.

About You

  • You have a top-class academic record: you'll have graduated with (or be on track for) a 1st class degree, or have attended one of the top universities in the country you studied in – we're looking for a strong, proven track record of academic performance as the clearest early signal of the analytical rigour this role needs.

  • You're curious about how technology fits together: you likely have a STEM background, and you enjoy working out how systems, data, and workflows connect to make a business run – even if you've never worked in RevOps before.

  • You want pace, eyes open: you're drawn to a fast-scaling business precisely because of the pace, and you understand that means longer hours and a steeper learning curve than a typical grad role. You see that as a trade worth making.

  • You're happy to get stuck in: you know not every task here is glamorous – some of it is spreadsheet clean-up, data hygiene, or repetitive admin – and you take real satisfaction in doing that work well, not just the exciting parts.

  • You want to understand how B2B SaaS businesses scale: you're looking to build a first-hand understanding of the GTM engine – pipeline, systems, data, and the commercial mechanics behind it – as a foundation for wherever your career goes next.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!
